verses.1:1: And it came about in the thirtieth year, in the fourth month, on the fifth of the month, while I was in the midst of the captivity by the river Chebar, that the heavens were opened, and I saw visions of God.
verses.1:2: On the fifth of the month, this was the fifth year of the captivity of King Jehoiakim,
verses.1:3: and the word of the Lord came to Ezekiel son of Buzi, the priest, in the land of the Chaldeans by the river Chebar. And the hand of the Lord came upon me.
verses.1:4: And I looked, and look, a sweeping wind was coming from the north, and a great cloud was in it, and brightness all around it, and flashing fire, and in the midst of it something like an appearance of amber in the midst of the fire, and brightness in it.
verses.1:5: And in the midst was something like a likeness of four living creatures; and this was their appearance: a likeness of a man was upon them.
verses.1:6: And each one had four faces, and each one had four wings.
verses.1:7: And their legs were straight, and their feet were winged, and there were sparks like flashing bronze; and their wings were light,
verses.1:8: and a man's hand was underneath their wings on their four sides.
verses.1:9: And the faces of the four of them did not turn as they walked; each one went straight before their face.
verses.1:10: And the likeness of their faces: a face of a man, and a face of a lion on the right for the four, and a face of a calf on the left for the four, and a face of an eagle for the four;
verses.1:11: and their wings were stretched out above for the four: each one had two joined to one another, and two covered over their body.
verses.1:12: And each one went straight before its face; wherever the spirit was going, they went, and they did not turn.
verses.1:13: And in the midst of the living creatures was an appearance like burning coals of fire, like the sight of torches whirling around in the midst of the living creatures, and brightness of the fire; and out of the fire lightning was going forth.
verses.1:15: And I looked, and look, one wheel was on the earth beside the living creatures, for the four.
verses.1:16: And the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of tharsis, and the four had one likeness; and their workmanship was as if a wheel were within a wheel.
verses.1:17: Toward their four sides they went; they did not turn as they went,
verses.1:18: nor did their backs, and they had height; and I saw them, and their backs were full of eyes all around for the four.
verses.1:19: And when the living creatures went, the wheels went beside them; and when the living creatures rose up from the earth, the wheels were lifted up.
verses.1:20: Wherever the cloud was, there was the spirit to go; the wheels went and were lifted up with them, because a spirit of life was in the wheels.
verses.1:21: When they went, they went, and when they stood, they stood, and when they rose up from the earth, they were lifted up with them, for a spirit of life was in the wheels.
verses.1:22: And a likeness was over the head of the living creatures like an expanse, like an appearance of crystal, stretched out over their wings above.
verses.1:23: And under the expanse their wings were stretched out, flapping one against the other; each one had two covering their bodies.
verses.1:24: And I heard the sound of their wings as they went, like the sound of much water; and when they stood, their wings rested.
verses.1:25: And look, there was a voice from above the expanse that was over their head.
verses.1:26: Like an appearance of sapphire stone, a likeness of a throne was upon it; and upon the likeness of the throne was a likeness like the appearance of a man above.
verses.1:27: And I saw something like the sight of amber from the appearance of the waist and upward; and from the appearance of the waist and all the way downward I saw something like an appearance of fire, and its brightness was all around.
verses.1:28: Like the appearance of a bow when it is in the cloud on days of rain, so was the state of the brightness all around.
verses.2:1: This was the vision of the likeness of the glory of the Lord. And I saw, and I fell upon my face, and I heard a voice of One speaking, and He said to me, "Son of man, stand upon your feet, and I will speak to you."
verses.2:2: And the Spirit came upon me, and took me up and lifted me up and stood me upon my feet; and I heard Him speaking to me,
verses.2:3: and He said to me, "Son of man, I am sending you out to the house of Israel, those who provoke Me, who have provoked Me, they and their fathers, to this day,
verses.2:4: and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord,'
verses.2:5: whether indeed they hear or are terrified, because it is a provoking house, and they will know that you are a prophet in their midst.
verses.2:6: And you, son of man, do not fear them, nor be dismayed before their face, because they will rage and band together against you all around, and in the midst of scorpions you dwell. Do not fear their words, and do not be dismayed before their face, because it is a provoking house.
verses.2:7: And you shall speak My words to them, whether indeed they hear or are terrified, for it is a provoking house.
verses.2:8: And you, son of man, listen to the One speaking to you; do not become provoking like the provoking house. Open your mouth wide and eat what I give to you."
verses.2:9: And I looked, and look, a hand was stretched out to me, and in it was a scroll of a book.
verses.2:10: And He unrolled it before me, and in it the front and the back were written on; and there was written lamentation and melody and woe.
verses.3:1: And He said to me, "Son of man, eat up this scroll, and go and speak to the sons of Israel."
verses.3:2: And He opened my mouth, and He fed me the scroll.
verses.3:3: And He said to me, "Son of man, your mouth shall eat, and your belly shall be filled with this scroll that has been given to you." And I ate it, and it became in my mouth like sweet-tasting honey.
verses.3:4: And He said to me, "Son of man, walk and go in to the house of Israel and speak My words to them,
verses.3:5: because you are not being sent out to a people of unintelligible speech—to the house of Israel—
verses.3:6: nor to many peoples of foreign voice or foreign tongue, nor heavy in tongue, whose words you will not understand; and if I had sent you out to such as these, these would have listened to you.
verses.3:7: But the house of Israel will by no means be willing to listen to you, because they do not wish to listen to Me; for all the house of Israel are contentious and hard-hearted.
verses.3:8: And look, I have made your face strong against their faces, and your contention I will strengthen against their contention,
verses.3:9: and it shall be continually stronger than rock. Do not be afraid of them nor be terrified before their face, because it is a provoking house."
verses.3:10: And He said to me, "Son of man, all the words that I have spoken with you, receive into your heart and hear with your ears,
verses.3:11: and walk, go in to the captivity, to the sons of your people, and you shall speak to them, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord,' whether indeed they hear, whether indeed they yield."
verses.3:12: And the Spirit took me up, and I heard behind me, and I heard a sound of a great earthquake: "Blessed be the glory of the Lord from His place."
verses.3:13: And I saw the sound of the wings of the living creatures flapping one against the other, and the sound of the wheels beside them, and the sound of the earthquake.
verses.3:14: And the Spirit lifted me up and took me up, and I went in the impulse of my spirit, and the hand of the Lord was strong upon me.
verses.3:15: And I entered into the captivity aloft, and I went around those dwelling by the river Chebar, those who were there; and I sat there seven days, moving about in their midst.
verses.3:16: And it came about after the seven days that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.3:17: "Son of man, I have given you as a watchman to the house of Israel, and you shall hear a word from My mouth, and you shall threaten them from Me.
verses.3:18: When I say to the lawless one, 'You will surely be put to death,' and you do not warn him nor speak to warn the lawless one to turn from his ways so that he may live, that lawless one will die by his unrighteousness, and I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.3:19: And if you warn the lawless one, and he does not turn from his lawlessness and the way, that lawless one will die in his unrighteousness, and you will deliver your soul.
verses.3:20: And when a righteous one turns from his righteous deeds and commits a transgression, and I put the torment before his face, he will die, because you did not warn him; and in his sins he will die, because his righteous deeds will certainly not be remembered; and I will require his blood from your hand.
verses.3:21: But if you warn the righteous one not to sin, and he does not sin, the righteous one will surely live, because you warned him; and you will deliver your own soul."
verses.3:22: And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and He said to me, "Arise and go out into the plain, and there it will be spoken to you."
verses.3:23: And I arose and went out into the plain, and look, there the glory of the Lord was standing, just as the vision and just as the glory that I saw by the river Chebar; and I fell upon my face.
verses.3:24: And the Spirit came upon me and stood me upon my feet, and He spoke to me and said to me, "Go in and be shut up in the midst of your house.
verses.3:25: And you, son of man, look, bonds have been put upon you, and they will bind you with them, and you shall certainly not go out from their midst.
verses.3:26: And I will bind up your tongue, and you will become mute, and you will not be to them a man who reproves, because it is a provoking house.
verses.3:27: And when I speak to you, I will open your mouth, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Let the one who hears hear, and let the one who disobeys disobey,' because it is a provoking house."
verses.4:1: "And you, son of man, take for yourself a brick and you shall place it before your face, and you shall sketch on it a city, Jerusalem,
verses.4:2: and you shall set a blockade against it, and build ramparts against it, and throw up a palisade against it, and set camps against it, and position the missile emplacements all around.
verses.4:3: And you, take for yourself an iron pan and you shall place it as an iron wall between you and the city, and you shall prepare your face against it, and it will be under siege, and you shall besiege it. This is a sign to the sons of Israel.
verses.4:4: And you shall lie down on your left side, and you shall lay the iniquities of the house of Israel upon it according to the number of the days, one hundred and fifty, that you will lie on it, and you shall bear their iniquities.
verses.4:5: And I have given you their two iniquities as a number of days, one hundred and ninety days, and you shall bear the iniquities of the house of Israel.
verses.4:6: And you shall complete these, and you shall lie down on your right side, and you shall bear the iniquities of the house of Judah for forty days; I have appointed for you a day for a year.
verses.4:7: And toward the siege of Jerusalem you shall prepare your face, and you shall strengthen your arm, and you shall prophesy against it.
verses.4:8: And look, I have placed bonds upon you, and do not turn from your one side to your other side until the days of your siege are completed.
verses.4:9: And you, take for yourself wheat and barley and beans and lentils and millet and spelt, and you shall put them into one earthenware vessel, and you shall make them for yourself into loaves, and according to the number of the days that you sleep on your side, one hundred and ninety days, you shall eat them.
verses.4:10: And you shall eat your food by weight, twenty shekels a day; from time to time you shall eat them.
verses.4:11: And you shall drink water by measure; a sixth of a hin you shall drink from time to time.
verses.4:12: And you shall eat them as a barley ash-cake; you shall bake them in dung of human excrement before their eyes,
verses.4:13: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord God of Israel: In this way the sons of Israel will eat unclean things among the nations.'"
verses.4:14: And I said, "By no means, Lord God of Israel! Surely my soul has not been defiled with uncleanness, and I have not eaten anything torn by wild beasts or anything that died of itself from my birth until now, nor has any stale meat entered my mouth."
verses.4:15: And He said to me, "Look, I have given you cow dung instead of human dung, and you shall make your loaves over it."
verses.4:16: And He said to me, "Son of man, look, I am breaking the support of bread in Jerusalem, and they will eat bread by weight and in want, and they will drink water by measure and in desolation,
verses.4:17: so that they may be in want of bread and water; and a man and his brother will be devastated, and they will waste away in their iniquities."
verses.5:1: "And you, son of man, take for yourself a sword sharper than a barber's razor; you shall acquire it for yourself, and you shall bring it over your head and over your beard. And you shall take a balance of weights and divide them:
verses.5:2: a fourth you shall burn in fire in the middle of the city at the completion of the days of the siege, and you shall take a fourth and burn it up in its midst, and a fourth you shall cut up with a sword around it, and a fourth you shall scatter to the wind, and I will unsheathe a sword after them.
verses.5:3: And you shall take from there a few in number and wrap them up in your cloak.
verses.5:4: And again you shall take some of these and throw them into the middle of the fire, and burn them up in fire; from it fire will go out. And you shall say to the whole house of Israel,
verses.5:5: 'Thus says the Lord: This is Jerusalem; in the midst of the nations I have set her, and the countries around her.
verses.5:6: And you shall speak My ordinances to the lawless one from the nations, and My statutes from the countries around her, because they rejected My ordinances, and in My statutes they did not walk in them.
verses.5:7: Therefore, thus says the Lord: Because your impulse is from the nations around you, and you did not walk in My statutes, and you did not do My ordinances, nor have you even acted according to the ordinances of the nations around you,
verses.5:8: therefore, thus says the Lord: Look, I am against you, and I will execute judgment in your midst before the nations,
verses.5:9: and I will do in you things that I have not done and the like of which I will not do again, according to all your abominations.
verses.5:10: Therefore, fathers will eat children in your midst, and children will eat fathers; and I will execute judgments in you, and I will scatter all your survivors to every wind.
verses.5:11: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, surely because you defiled My holy things with all your abominations, I too will reject you; My eye will not spare, and I too will show no mercy.
verses.5:12: A fourth of you will be consumed by death, and a fourth of you will be brought to an end by famine in your midst, and a fourth of you, I will scatter them to every wind, and a fourth of you will fall by sword around you, and I will unsheathe a sword after them.
verses.5:13: And My wrath and My anger will be brought to an end upon them, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken in My zeal, when I bring My anger to an end upon them.
verses.5:14: And I will make you a wasteland, and your daughters around you, before everyone who passes by,
verses.5:15: and you will be lamented and wretched among the nations around you, when I execute judgments in you in the vengeance of My wrath; I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.5:16: And when I send out My arrows of famine upon them, they will be for extinction, and I will break your support of bread.
verses.5:17: And I will send out upon you famine and evil wild beasts, and I will punish you, and death and blood will pass through upon you, and I will bring a sword upon you from all around; I, the Lord, have spoken.'"
verses.6:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.6:2: "Son of man, set your face firmly against the mountains of Israel and prophesy against them,
verses.6:3: and you shall say, 'Mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord! Thus says the Lord to the mountains and to the hills and to the ravines and to the valleys: Look, I am bringing a sword upon you, and your high places will be utterly destroyed,
verses.6:4: and your altars and your shrines will be broken, and I will cast down your wounded before your idols,
verses.6:5: and I will scatter your bones around your altars.
verses.6:6: In all your habitation the cities will be laid waste and the high places will be devastated, so that your altars may be utterly destroyed and your idols broken and your shrines removed,
verses.6:7: and wounded ones will fall in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.6:8: When there are those of you who escape from the sword among the nations, and in your dispersion in the countries,
verses.6:9: then those of you who escape will remember Me among the nations where they were taken captive; I have sworn to their heart that prostitutes itself away from Me and to their eyes that prostitute themselves after their practices, and they will beat their faces for all their abominations;
verses.6:10: and they will know that I, the Lord, have spoken.'"
verses.6:11: Thus says the Lord: "Clap with your hand and stamp with your foot and say, 'Aha, aha!' over all the abominations of the house of Israel; by sword and by death and by famine they will fall.
verses.6:12: The one who is near will fall by sword, and the one who is far off will perish by death, and the one who is besieged will be brought to an end by famine, and I will bring My anger to an end upon them.
verses.6:13: And you will know that I am the Lord, when your wounded are in the midst of your idols around your altars, on every high hill and under a shady tree, where they gave a fragrant aroma to all their idols.
verses.6:14: And I will stretch out My hand against them, and I will make the land a desolation and a destruction from the wilderness of Deblatha, from all the habitation; and you will know that I am the Lord."
verses.7:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.7:2: "And you, son of man, say, 'Thus says the Lord to the land of Israel: An end has come; the end has come upon the four wings of the land.
verses.7:4: upon you who dwell in the land; the time has come, the day has drawn near, not with tumults nor with birth pains.
verses.7:5: Now soon I will pour out My wrath upon you, and I will complete My fury against you, and I will judge you in your ways, and I will put all your abominations upon you.
verses.7:6: My eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy; because I will put your ways upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord who strikes.
verses.7:7: Now the end is upon you, and I will send against you and execute vengeance in your ways, and I will put all your abominations upon you.
verses.7:8: My eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy; because I will put your way upon you, and your abominations will be in your midst, and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.7:9: For thus says the Lord: Look, the end has come,
verses.7:10: look, the day of the Lord. Even though the rod has blossomed, arrogance has risen up.
verses.7:11: And He will shatter the support of a lawless one, and not with tumult nor with haste.
verses.7:12: The time has come; look, the day. Let the buyer not rejoice, and let the seller not mourn,
verses.7:13: for the buyer will no longer return to the seller, and a man will not hold fast in the eye of his life.
verses.7:14: Sound a trumpet and judge all things.
verses.7:15: War with the sword is outside, and famine and death are inside; the one in the plain will die by the sword, and famine and death will finish off those in the city.
verses.7:16: And those escaping from them will escape and be on the mountains; I will kill them all, each one in his injustices.
verses.7:17: All hands will grow limp, and all thighs will be soiled with moisture,
verses.7:18: and they will gird themselves with sackcloth, and horror will cover them; and on every face there will be shame upon them, and on every head baldness.
verses.7:19: Their silver will be thrown in the streets, and their gold will be disregarded; their souls will certainly not be satisfied, and their bellies will certainly not be filled, because it became a torment of their injustices.
verses.7:20: Choice things of adornment, they set them for pride, and they made images of their abominations out of them; because of this I have given them to them for uncleanness.
verses.7:21: And I will hand them over into the hands of foreigners to plunder them, and to the pestilent ones of the earth for spoil, and they will profane them.
verses.7:22: And I will turn My face away from them, and they will defile My oversight, and they will enter into them unguardedly and profane them,
verses.7:23: and they will cause confusion, because the land is full of peoples, and the city is full of lawlessness.
verses.7:24: And I will turn back the insolence of their strength, and their holy places will be defiled.
verses.7:25: Propitiation will come and seek peace, and there will be none.
verses.7:26: Woe upon woe will come, and report upon report will come; and a vision will be sought from a prophet, and law will perish from a priest, and counsel from elders.
verses.7:27: A ruler will clothe himself with desolation, and the hands of the people of the land will be paralyzed; according to their ways I will do to them, and in their judgments I will execute vengeance on them, and they will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.8:1: And it happened in the sixth year, in the fifth month, on the fifth of the month, that I was sitting in the house, and the elders of Judah were sitting before me. And the hand of the Lord came upon me,
verses.8:2: and I looked, and look, a likeness of a man: from His waist and downward was fire, and from His waist upward was like the appearance of amber.
verses.8:3: And He stretched out a likeness of a hand and took me up by the crown of my head, and the Spirit lifted me up between the earth and heaven and brought me to Jerusalem in a vision of God, to the entrance of the gate facing north, where the pillar of the acquirer was.
verses.8:4: And look, there was the glory of the Lord God of Israel, according to the vision that I saw in the plain.
verses.8:5: And He said to me, "Son of man, look up with your eyes toward the north." And I looked up with my eyes toward the north, and look, from the north toward the gate of the one facing east.
verses.8:6: And He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen what these people are doing? They are doing great lawless deeds here, so as to keep away from My holy places; and you will yet see greater lawless deeds."
verses.8:7: And He brought me in to the entrance of the court,
verses.8:8: and He said to me, "Son of man, dig." And I dug, and look, a door.
verses.8:9: And He said to me, "Go in and see the lawless deeds that these people are doing here."
verses.8:10: And I went in and looked, and look, vain abominations and all the idols of the house of Israel depicted on it all around.
verses.8:11: And there were seventy men from the elders of the house of Israel; Jeconiah son of Shaphan was standing in their midst before them, and each one had his censer in his hand, and the vapor of the incense was rising.
verses.8:12: And He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man, what the elders of the house of Israel are doing, each of them in their secret bedchamber? For they said, 'The Lord does not see; the Lord has forsaken the land.'"
verses.8:13: And He said to me, "You will yet see greater lawless deeds that these people are doing."
verses.8:14: And He brought me in to the entrance of the gate of the house of the Lord facing north, and look, women were sitting there, mourning for Tammuz.
verses.8:15: And He said to me, "Son of man, have you seen? And you will yet see practices greater than these."
verses.8:16: And He brought me into the inner court of the house of the Lord, and at the entrance of the temple of the Lord, between the porticoes and the altar, were about twenty men, with their backs toward the temple of the Lord and their faces in the opposite direction, and they were bowing down to the sun.
verses.8:17: And He said to me, "Have you seen, son of man? Is it a small thing for the house of Judah to do the lawless deeds that they have done here? For they filled the land with lawlessness, and look, they are like those who sneer.
verses.8:18: And I will act toward them with fury; My eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy."
verses.9:1: And He cried out in my ears with a loud voice, saying, "The vengeance of the city has drawn near." And each one had the instruments of destruction in his hand.
verses.9:2: And look, six men were coming from the way of the high gate facing north, and each one's axe was in his hand; and one man in their midst was clothed in a full-length robe, and a sash of sapphire was on his waist; and they went in and stood next to the bronze altar.
verses.9:3: And the glory of the God of Israel went up from the cherubim, which was upon them, to the open court of the house.
verses.9:4: And He called the man clothed in the full-length robe, who had a sash on his waist, and said to him, "Pass through the midst of Jerusalem, and put a mark on the foreheads of the men who groan deeply and who are deeply grieved over all the lawless deeds being done in their midst."
verses.9:5: And to these He said in my hearing, "Go after him into the city, and strike, and do not spare with your eyes, and do not show mercy;
verses.9:6: kill old man and young man and virgin and infants and women to extermination, but do not draw near to any on whom the mark is; begin from My holy places." And they began from the elder men who were inside the house.
verses.9:7: And He said to them, "Defile the house, and fill the roads with the dead as you go out, and strike."
verses.9:8: And it happened, while they were striking, that I fell on my face, and I cried aloud and said, "Alas, Lord, are You wiping out those remaining of Israel when You pour out Your fury upon Jerusalem?"
verses.9:9: And He said to me, "The injustice of the house of Israel and Judah has grown very, very great, because the land was filled with many peoples, and the city was filled with injustice and uncleanness; because they said, 'The Lord has forsaken the land; the Lord does not look on.'
verses.9:10: And My eye will not spare, nor will I show mercy; I have put their ways upon their heads."
verses.9:11: And look, the man clothed in the full-length robe and girded at his waist with the sash answered, saying, "I have done just as You commanded me."
verses.10:1: And I saw, and look, above the expanse that was over the heads of the cherubim, like a sapphire stone, a likeness of a throne was upon them.
verses.10:2: And He said to the man clothed in the robe, "Go into the midst of the wheels that are beneath the cherubim, and fill your hands with coals of fire from the midst of the cherubim, and scatter them over the city." And he went in before me.
verses.10:3: And the cherubim were standing on the right side of the house as the man went in, and the cloud filled the inner court.
verses.10:4: And the glory of the Lord departed from the cherubim to the open court of the house, and the cloud filled the house, and the court was filled with the brightness of the glory of the Lord.
verses.10:5: And the sound of the wings of the cherubim was heard as far as the outer court, like the voice of God Shaddai speaking.
verses.10:6: And it happened, when He commanded the man clothed in the holy robe, saying, "Take fire from the midst of the wheels, from the midst of the cherubim," that he went in and stood beside the wheels.
verses.10:7: And he stretched out his hand into the midst of the fire that was in the midst of the cherubim, and he took some and put it into the hands of the one clothed in the holy robe, and he took it and went out.
verses.10:8: And I saw the cherubim, a likeness of men's hands beneath their wings.
verses.10:9: And I saw, and look, four wheels were standing beside the cherubim, one wheel beside one cherub, and the appearance of the wheels was like the appearance of a carbuncle stone.
verses.10:10: And their appearance was one likeness for the four, just as when a wheel is in the midst of a wheel.
verses.10:11: When they went, they went in their four directions; they did not turn as they went, because to whatever place the one head looked, they went, and they did not turn as they went.
verses.10:12: And their backs and their hands and their wings and the wheels were full of eyes all around on the four wheels.
verses.10:13: And these wheels were called Gelgel in my hearing.
verses.10:15: And the cherubim were this living creature that I saw by the river Chebar.
verses.10:16: And when the cherubim went, the wheels went, and these were beside them; and when the cherubim lifted up their wings to rise from the earth, their wheels did not turn.
verses.10:17: When they stood, these stood, and when they rose, these rose with them, because a spirit of life was in them.
verses.10:18: And the glory of the Lord went out from the house and mounted upon the cherubim,
verses.10:19: and the cherubim lifted up their wings and rose from the earth before me; as they went out, the wheels also were beside them; and they stood at the entrance of the gate of the house of the Lord that is opposite, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them above.
verses.10:20: This is the living creature that I saw beneath the God of Israel by the river Chebar, and I knew that they were cherubim.
verses.10:21: Each one had four faces, and each one had eight wings, and a likeness of a man's hands was beneath their wings.
verses.10:22: And as for the likeness of their faces, these are the faces that I saw beneath the glory of the God of Israel by the river Chebar, and they each went straight before their faces.
verses.11:1: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the gate of the house of the Lord that is opposite, which faces east. And at the entrance of the gate were about twenty-five men, and I saw in their midst Jeconiah the son of Ezer and Pelatiah the son of Benaiah, the leaders of the people.
verses.11:2: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, these are the men who devise futile things and plan wicked counsel in this city,
verses.11:3: who say, 'Have the houses not recently been built? This is the pot, and we are the meat.'
verses.11:4: Therefore prophesy against them; prophesy, son of man."
verses.11:5: And the Spirit fell upon me and said to me, "Say, 'Thus says the Lord: So you have spoken, house of Israel, and the thoughts of your spirit I know.
verses.11:6: You have multiplied your dead in this city, and you have filled their streets with those struck down.
verses.11:7: Therefore, thus says the Lord: Your dead whom you struck down in its midst, they are the meat, and this is the pot, and I will bring you out from its midst.
verses.11:8: You fear a sword, and a sword I will bring upon you, says the Lord.
verses.11:9: And I will bring you out from its midst, and I will hand you over into the hands of foreigners, and I will execute judgments among you.
verses.11:10: By the sword you will fall; on the mountains of Israel I will judge you, and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.11:13: And it happened, as I was prophesying, that Pelatiah the son of Benaiah died. And I fell on my face and cried out with a loud voice and said, "Alas, alas, Lord! Are You bringing the remnant of Israel to a complete end?"
verses.11:14: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.11:15: "Son of man, your brothers and the men of your captivity and all the house of Israel have been brought to an end, to whom the inhabitants of Jerusalem said, 'Keep far away from the Lord; to us the land has been given as an inheritance.'
verses.11:16: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: I will cast them off among the nations, and I will scatter them into every land, and I will be to them a small sanctuary in the countries wherever they enter.'
verses.11:17: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: I will also receive them from the nations, and I will gather them from the countries where I dispersed them, and I will give them the land of Israel.
verses.11:18: And they will enter there, and they will remove all its abominations and all its lawless deeds from it.
verses.11:19: And I will give them a different heart, and a new spirit I will put within them; and I will pull out the heart of stone from their flesh and give them a heart of flesh,
verses.11:20: so that they may walk in My statutes, and keep My ordinances and carry them out; and they will be a people to Me, and I will be God to them.
verses.11:21: And toward the heart of their abominations and their lawless deeds, as their heart was going, I have put their ways upon their heads, says the Lord.'"
verses.11:22: And the cherubim lifted up their wings, and the wheels were beside them, and the glory of the God of Israel was over them, above them.
verses.11:23: And the glory of the Lord went up from the midst of the city and stood upon the mountain that was opposite the city.
verses.11:24: And the Spirit lifted me up and brought me to the land of the Chaldeans, to the captivity, in a vision by the Spirit of God. And I went up from the vision that I saw,
verses.11:25: and I spoke to the captivity all the words of the Lord that He had shown me.
verses.12:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:2: "Son of man, you dwell in the midst of their injustices, those who have eyes to see and do not see, and have ears to hear and do not hear, because it is a provoking house.
verses.12:3: And you, son of man, make for yourself baggage for captivity by day before them, and you will be taken captive from your place to another place before them, so that they may know that it is a provoking house.
verses.12:4: And you will bring out your baggage, baggage for captivity, by day before their eyes; and you yourself will go out in the evening as a captive goes out
verses.12:5: before them. Dig for yourself into the wall, and you will pass out through it.
verses.12:6: Before them you will be lifted up on shoulders, and you will go out concealed; you will cover your face and will by no means see the land, because I have given you as a portent to the house of Israel."
verses.12:7: And I did so, according to all that He commanded me, and I brought out baggage for captivity by day, and in the evening I dug through the wall for myself and went out concealed; I was lifted up on shoulders before them.
verses.12:8: And the word of the Lord came to me in the morning, saying,
verses.12:9: "Son of man, did not the house of Israel, the provoking house, say to you, 'What are you doing?'
verses.12:10: Say to them, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: The prince and the leader in Jerusalem, and to all the house of Israel who are in their midst.'
verses.12:11: Say, 'I am performing portents; just as I have done, so it will be to him; in exile and in captivity they will go.
verses.12:12: And the prince in their midst will be lifted up on shoulders, and he will go out concealed through the wall, and he will dig through so that he may go out through it. He will cover his face so that he may not be seen by an eye, and he himself will not see the land.
verses.12:13: And I will spread out My net over him, and he will be caught in My enclosure, and I will bring him to Babylon, to the land of the Chaldeans, and he will not see it, and there he will die.
verses.12:14: And all those around him, his helpers, and all those who support him, I will disperse to every wind, and I will unsheathe a sword after them.
verses.12:15: And they will know that I am the Lord when I scatter them among the nations, and I will disperse them in the countries.
verses.12:16: And I will leave behind from them men few in number from the sword and from famine and from death, so that they may recount all their lawless deeds among the nations where they entered, and they will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.12:17: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:18: "Son of man, you will eat your bread with anguish, and you will drink water with torment and affliction.
verses.12:19: And you will say to the people of the land, 'Thus says the Lord to the inhabitants of Jerusalem in the land of Israel: They will eat their loaves with scarcity, and they will drink their water with desolation, so that the land may be made desolate along with its fullness, for all those who dwell in it are in ungodliness.
verses.12:20: And their inhabited cities will be laid waste, and the land will become a desolation; and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.12:21: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:22: "Son of man, what is the proverb you have in the land of Israel, saying, 'The days are long, vision has perished'?
verses.12:23: Therefore say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: I will turn back this proverb, and the house of Israel will no longer say this proverb,' for you will speak to them, 'The days have drawn near, and the word of every vision.
verses.12:24: For there will no longer be any false vision or one who divines flattering things in the midst of the sons of Israel.
verses.12:25: Because I, the Lord, will speak My words; I will speak and I will do it, and I will no longer delay; for in your days, provoking house, I will speak a word and I will do it, says the Lord.'"
verses.12:26: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.12:27: "Son of man, look, the provoking house of Israel keep saying, 'The vision that this man sees is for many days, and for distant times this man prophesies.'
verses.12:28: Therefore say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: None of My words that I speak will be delayed any longer; I will speak and I will do it, says the Lord.'"
verses.13:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.13:2: "Son of man, prophesy against the prophets of Israel, and you shall prophesy and say to them, 'Hear the word of the Lord:
verses.13:3: Thus says the Lord: Woe to those who prophesy from their own heart and do not see at all.
verses.13:4: Like foxes in the deserts are your prophets, Israel.
verses.13:5: They did not stand in steadfastness, and they gathered flocks against the house of Israel; those who say, "In the day of the Lord," did not rise up,
verses.13:6: seeing falsehoods, divining vain things, those who say, "The Lord says," yet the Lord has not sent them, and they began to establish a word.
verses.13:7: Have you not seen a false vision and spoken vain divinations?'
verses.13:8: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: Because your words are false and your divinations are vain, therefore, look, I am against you, says the Lord,
verses.13:9: and I will stretch out My hand against the prophets who see falsehoods and who utter vain things. They will not be in the instruction of My people, nor will they be written in the register of the house of Israel, and they will not enter into the land of Israel; and they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.13:10: Because they led My people astray, saying, "Peace," and there was no peace; and this one builds a wall, and they plaster it; it will fall.'
verses.13:11: Say to those who plaster, 'It will fall, and there will be a flooding rain, and I will put catapult stones into their joints, and they will fall, and a sweeping wind, and it will be torn apart.
verses.13:12: And look, the wall has fallen, and will they not say to you, "Where is your plaster that you plastered?"
verses.13:13: Therefore thus says the Lord: And I will break loose a sweeping blast with wrath, and there will be a flooding rain in My anger, and in wrath I will bring the catapult stones to complete destruction,
verses.13:14: and I will tear down the wall that you plastered; it will fall. And I will lay it on the ground, and its foundations will be uncovered, and it will fall, and you will be brought to an end with rebukes; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.13:15: And I will complete My wrath upon the wall and upon those who plaster it; it will fall. And I said to you, "The wall is no more, nor those who plaster it,"
verses.13:16: the prophets of Israel, who prophesy concerning Jerusalem and who see peace for her, and there is no peace, says the Lord.'
verses.13:17: And you, son of man, set your face against the daughters of your people who prophesy from their own heart, and prophesy against them,
verses.13:18: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord: Woe to the women who sew pillows under every elbow of a hand and who make veils upon every head of every stature, in order to pervert souls. The souls of My people were perverted, and they were preserving souls alive,
verses.13:19: and they were profaning Me among My people for a handful of barley and for pieces of bread, to put to death souls that should not die and to preserve alive souls that should not live, by your uttering vain utterances to a people who listen.
verses.13:20: Therefore thus says the Lord, the Lord: Look, I am against your pillows, upon which you round up souls there, and I will tear them from your arms, and I will send away the souls, whose souls you twist away, into dispersion,
verses.13:21: and I will tear apart your veils, and I will deliver My people from your hand, and they will no longer be in your hands for rounding up; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.13:22: Because you were perverting the heart of a righteous man, when I was not perverting him, and to strengthen the hands of a lawless man, not to turn back at all from his evil way so that he might live,
verses.13:23: therefore you shall by no means see falsehoods, and you shall no longer divine divinations, and I will deliver My people from your hand; and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.14:1: And men from the elders of Israel came to me, and sat before my face.
verses.14:2: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.14:3: "Son of man, these men have set their thoughts upon their hearts, and they have placed the punishment of their iniquities before their face; should I indeed answer them?
verses.14:4: Therefore speak to them, and you shall say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Any man from the house of Israel who sets his thoughts upon his heart, and places the punishment of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet, I, the Lord, will answer him in the things in which his mind is entangled,
verses.14:5: so that it may turn aside the house of Israel according to their hearts that are estranged from Me in their devices.'
verses.14:6: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Turn back and turn away from your practices and from all your impieties, and turn back your faces.
verses.14:7: For any man from the house of Israel and from the sojourners who sojourn in Israel who becomes estranged from Me, and sets his devices upon his heart, and places the punishment of his iniquity before his face, and comes to the prophet to inquire of him concerning Me, I, the Lord, will answer him in that in which he is entangled.
verses.14:8: And I will set My face against that man, and I will make him a wasteland and a desolation, and I will remove him from the midst of My people; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.14:9: And if the prophet misleads and speaks, I, the Lord, have misled that prophet, and I will stretch out My hand against him and wipe him out from the midst of My people Israel.
verses.14:10: And they will bear their iniquity; according to the wrongdoing of the one who inquires, likewise according to the wrongdoing it will be for the prophet,
verses.14:11: so that the house of Israel may no longer go astray from Me, and that they may no longer be defiled in all their transgressions; and they will be a people to Me, and I will be God to them, says the Lord.'"
verses.14:12: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.14:13: "Son of man, whatever land sins against Me by committing a transgression, I will stretch out My hand against it and break its support of bread, and I will send out famine upon it and remove from it man and beasts.
verses.14:14: And if these three men are in its midst, Noah and Daniel and Job, they themselves will be saved by their righteousness, says the Lord.
verses.14:15: If I also bring evil wild animals upon the land and I punish it, and it becomes a desolation, and there is no one passing through because of the wild animals,
verses.14:16: and these three men are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters will be saved, but rather they alone will be saved, and the land will be for destruction.
verses.14:17: Or if I also bring a sword upon that land and say, 'Let a sword pass through the land,' and I remove from it man and beast,
verses.14:18: and these three men are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, they will by no means deliver sons or daughters; they alone will be saved.
verses.14:19: Or if I also send death upon that land and pour out My wrath upon it in blood to utterly destroy from it man and beast,
verses.14:20: and Noah and Daniel and Job are in its midst, as I live, says the Lord, neither sons nor daughters will be left behind; they themselves by their righteousness will deliver their own souls.
verses.14:21: Thus says the Lord: Even if I also send out My four evil acts of vengeance, sword and famine and evil wild animals and death, upon Jerusalem to utterly destroy from her man and beast,
verses.14:22: yet look, left behind in her are those of her who have been saved, who lead out from her sons and daughters; look, they are coming out to you, and you will see their ways
verses.14:23: and their devices, and you will know that I have not done in vain all that I did in her, says the Lord."
verses.15:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.15:2: "And you, son of man, what could become of the wood of the vine out of all the woods that are among the trees of the forest?
verses.15:3: Will they take wood from it to make for work? Will they take a peg from it to hang any vessel upon it?
verses.15:4: Apart from that, it has been given to fire for consumption; the fire consumes the yearly pruning from it, and it fails completely. Will it be useful for work?
verses.15:5: Not even while it is still whole will it be for work? How much less, if fire also consumes it completely, will it still be for work?
verses.15:6: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: Just as the wood of the vine among the trees of the forest, which I have given to fire for consumption, so I have given the inhabitants of Jerusalem.
verses.15:7: And I will set My face against them; from the fire they will come out, and fire will devour them, and they will know that I am the Lord, when I set My face against them.
verses.15:8: And I will give the land over to desolation, because they committed a transgression, says the Lord.'"
verses.16:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.16:2: "Son of man, testify to Jerusalem of her lawless deeds,
verses.16:3: and you shall say, Thus says the Lord to Jerusalem: Your root and your birth are from the land of Canaan; your father was an Amorite, and your mother a Hittite.
verses.16:4: And as for your birth, on the day you were born you did not bind your breasts, and you were not washed in water, nor were you salted with salt, and you were not swaddled in swaddling cloths,
verses.16:5: nor did My eye spare you out of all these things, so as to feel anything for you; and you were cast out onto the face of the field in the crookedness of your soul on the day you were born.
verses.16:6: And I passed by you and saw you defiled in the blood, and I said to you, 'Out of your blood, life;
verses.16:7: multiply!' Like the growth of the field I have made you; and you multiplied and grew great, and you entered into cities of cities. Your breasts stood upright, and your hair sprang up, yet you were naked and indecent.
verses.16:8: And I passed by you and saw you, and look, it was your time, and a time of those who lodge; and I spread out My wings over you and covered your indecency, and I swore to you and entered into a covenant with you, says the Lord, and you became Mine.
verses.16:9: And I washed you in water, and I washed off your blood from you, and I anointed you with oil;
verses.16:10: and I clothed you with embroidered garments, and I shod you with hyacinth-blue, and I girded you with fine linen, and I wrapped you in fine-spun cloth;
verses.16:11: and I adorned you with ornament, and I placed bracelets around your hands and a necklace around your neck;
verses.16:12: and I put a ring in your nostril and round earrings on your ears and a crown of boasting on your head;
verses.16:13: and you were adorned with gold and silver, and your wraps were of fine linen and fine-spun cloth and embroidered work; fine flour and oil and honey you ate, and you became exceedingly beautiful.
verses.16:14: And a name went out for you among the nations for your beauty, because it was perfected in splendor, in the loveliness that I placed upon you, says the Lord.
verses.16:15: You trusted in your beauty and prostituted yourself because of your name, and you poured out your prostitution upon every passerby.
verses.16:16: And you took from your garments and made for yourself stitched idols, and you prostituted yourself upon them; and you shall by no means enter, nor shall it come to be.
verses.16:17: And you took the articles of your boasting from My gold and from My silver, from what I gave you, and you made for yourself male images and prostituted yourself with them,
verses.16:18: and you took your embroidered clothing and wrapped them, and My oil and My incense you set before their face,
verses.16:19: and My loaves that I gave you—fine flour and oil and honey I fed you—you set them before their face for an aroma of sweet fragrance. And it happened, says the Lord,
verses.16:20: and you took your sons and your daughters whom you bore, and sacrificed them to them for consumption; as though you had prostituted yourself little,
verses.16:21: and you slaughtered your children and gave them when you offered them in appeasement to them.
verses.16:22: This was beyond all your prostitution, and you did not remember your infancy, the day when you were naked and indecent; defiled in your blood, you lived.
verses.16:23: And it happened after all your evil deeds, says the Lord,
verses.16:24: and you built for yourself a house of prostitution, and you made for yourself a public stand in every square,
verses.16:25: and at the head of every road you built your brothels and ruined your beauty, and you parted your legs to every passerby and multiplied your prostitution,
verses.16:26: and you prostituted yourself with the sons of Egypt, who border on you, those of great flesh, and in many ways you prostituted yourself, to provoke Me to anger.
verses.16:27: But if I stretch out My hand against you, then I will remove your ordinances and deliver you into the souls of those who hate you, the daughters of the foreigners who turn you aside from your way. You acted impiously
verses.16:28: and you prostituted yourself with the daughters of Assyria, and not even so were you satisfied; and you prostituted yourself and were not being satisfied.
verses.16:29: And you multiplied your covenants with the land of the Chaldeans, and not even with these were you satisfied.
verses.16:30: How should I deal with your daughter, says the Lord, when you have done all these things, the deeds of a prostitute woman? And you prostituted yourself threefold among your daughters;
verses.16:31: you built the brothel at the head of every road, and you made your pedestal in every square. And you became like a prostitute gathering wages.
verses.16:32: The woman who commits adultery is like you; receiving wages from her husband, she gave wages in addition to all those who prostituted her;
verses.16:33: and you have given wages to all your lovers, and you loaded them down so that they would come to you from all around in your prostitution.
verses.16:34: And something perverted happened in you contrary to the women in your prostitution, and with you they have committed prostitution in your giving wages, and wages were not given to you, and perverted things happened in you.
verses.16:35: Therefore, prostitute, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.16:36: Thus says the Lord: Because you poured out your bronze, and your shame will be uncovered in your prostitution toward your lovers and toward all the devices of your lawless deeds and in the blood of your children whom you gave to them,
verses.16:37: therefore, look, I am gathering together all your lovers with whom you mingled, and all whom you loved together with all whom you hated; and I will gather them against you from all around and uncover your evil deeds to them, and they will see all your shame;
verses.16:38: and I will punish you with the punishment of an adulteress, and I will place you in blood of wrath and jealousy.
verses.16:39: And I will deliver you into their hands, and they will tear down your brothel and pull down your pedestal, and they will strip you of your garments and take the articles of your boasting, and they will leave you naked and indecent.
verses.16:40: And they will bring crowds against you, and they will stone you with stones, and they will slaughter you with their swords,
verses.16:41: and they will burn your houses with fire, and execute punishments on you before many women; and I will turn you back from prostitution, and you shall by no means give wages anymore.
verses.16:42: And I will let loose My wrath upon you, and My jealousy will be removed from you; and I will rest, and I will by no means be anxious anymore.
verses.16:43: Because you did not remember your infancy, and you kept grieving Me in all these things, look, I too have put your ways upon your head, says the Lord; and thus you committed impiety in addition to all your lawless deeds.
verses.16:44: These are all the things that they said against you in a proverb, saying, 'Like the mother,
verses.16:45: so the daughter.' You are the daughter of your mother, the one who rejected her husband and her children, and sisters of your sisters, those who rejected their husbands and their children; your mother was a Hittite, and your father an Amorite.
verses.16:46: Your older sister is Samaria, she and her daughters, who dwells on your left; and your sister younger than you, who dwells on your right, is Sodom and her daughters.
verses.16:47: And not even so did you walk in their ways, nor did you act according to their lawless deeds; in a little while you even surpass them in all your ways.
verses.16:48: As I live, says the Lord, Sodom, she and her daughters, have surely not done in the way that you and your daughters did.
verses.16:49: However, this was the lawlessness of your sister Sodom: arrogance; in fullness of bread and in prosperity they lived in luxury, she and her daughters; this belonged to her and to her daughters; and they did not take hold of the hand of the poor and needy,
verses.16:50: and they boasted arrogantly and committed acts of lawlessness before Me, and I removed them just as I saw.
verses.16:51: And Samaria did not sin according to half of your sins; and you multiplied your lawless deeds beyond them, and you justified your sisters in all your lawless deeds that you committed.
verses.16:52: And you, bear your torment in which you corrupted your sisters by your sins in which you acted lawlessly beyond them, and you justified them beyond yourself; and you, be ashamed and take your dishonor in your justifying your sisters.
verses.16:53: And I will turn back their turnings away, the turning away of Sodom and her daughters, and I will turn back the turning away of Samaria and her daughters, and I will turn back your turning away in their midst,
verses.16:54: so that you may bear your torment and be dishonored because of all that you did in provoking Me to anger.
verses.16:55: And your sister Sodom and her daughters will be restored just as they were from the beginning; and you and your daughters will be restored just as you were from the beginning.
verses.16:56: And if your sister Sodom was not a report in your mouth in the days of your arrogance,
verses.16:57: before your evil deeds were uncovered, in the way that you are now a reproach of the daughters of Syria and of all those around her, the daughters of the foreigners who surround you all around,
verses.16:58: your impieties and your lawless deeds, you have borne them, says the Lord.
verses.16:59: Thus says the Lord: And I will do to you just as you did, since you dishonored these things so as to transgress My covenant.
verses.16:60: And I Myself will remember My covenant with you in the days of your infancy, and I will establish for you an everlasting covenant.
verses.16:61: And you will remember your way, and you will be utterly dishonored when you receive your sisters who are older than you together with those who are younger than you, and I will give them to you for building up and not from your covenant.
verses.16:62: And I Myself will establish My covenant with you, and you will know that I am the Lord;
verses.16:63: so that you may remember and be ashamed, and it may no longer be yours to open your mouth because of your dishonor, when I make atonement for you according to all that you did, says the Lord."
verses.17:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.17:2: "Son of man, recount a tale and speak a parable to the house of Israel,
verses.17:3: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord: The great eagle, great-winged, long in span, full of claws, who has the design to enter Lebanon, took the choice parts of the cedar.
verses.17:4: He plucked off the tips of the tender growth and brought them to the land of Canaan; in a walled city he placed them.
verses.17:5: And he took from the seed of the land and put it into the field as a plant beside much water; he set it as something watched over.
verses.17:6: And it sprouted and became a weak and small vine, so that it showed its branches over it, and its roots were underneath it. And it became a vine and produced offshoots and stretched out its climbing shoots.
verses.17:7: And there was another great eagle, great-winged, with many claws; and look, this vine was entwined toward him, and its roots were toward him, and it sent out its branches to him to water it together with the clod of its planting.
verses.17:8: In a good field beside much water it grows lush, to produce shoots and bear fruit, to become a great vine.'
verses.17:9: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: Will it prosper? Will not the roots of its tender growth and the fruit rot, and all its early sprouts dry up—and not with a great arm nor with many people to pull it out from its roots?
verses.17:10: And look, it grows lush; will it prosper? Will it not dry up as soon as the scorching wind touches it? Together with the clod of its sprouting it will dry up.'"
verses.17:11: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.17:12: "Son of man, say now to the provoking house, 'Do you not know what these things were?' Say, 'When the king of Babylon comes against Jerusalem, he will take its king and its rulers and will lead them to himself into Babylon.
verses.17:13: And he will take from the seed of the kingdom, and will make a covenant with him and bring him under a curse, and he will take the leaders of the land,
verses.17:14: so that it may become a weak kingdom, not to lift itself up at all, to keep his covenant and make it stand.
verses.17:15: And he will revolt from him by sending out his messengers to Egypt, to give him horses and many people. Will he prosper? Will the one who does contrary things be delivered? And one who transgresses a covenant, will he be delivered?
verses.17:16: As I live, says the Lord, surely in the place of the king who made him king, he who dishonored My curse and who transgressed My covenant will die with him in the midst of Babylon.
verses.17:17: And not with a great force nor with a large multitude will Pharaoh make war against him, with the throwing up of a rampart and with the building of siege-works to wipe out souls.
verses.17:18: And he dishonored an oath to transgress a covenant, and look, I have given his hand, and he did all these things to him; will he be saved?'
verses.17:19: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: As I live, surely My oath which he dishonored and My covenant which he transgressed, I will put it upon his head.
verses.17:20: And I will spread out the net over him, and he will be caught in his enclosure.
verses.17:21: In all his battle array they will fall by the sword, and the remaining ones I will scatter to every wind; and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.17:22: For thus says the Lord: I Myself will also take from the choice parts of the cedar, from the top; I will pluck off their hearts, and I Myself will plant on a high mountain,
verses.17:23: and I will hang it on a lofty mountain of Israel and plant it, and it will put forth a shoot and produce fruit and become a great cedar; and underneath it every bird will rest, and every winged creature will rest under its shadow; its branches will be restored.
verses.17:24: And all the trees of the field will know that I am the Lord who brings low a high tree and exalts a low tree, and dries up a green tree and makes a dry tree flourish. I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will do it.'"
verses.18:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.18:2: "Son of man, what is this proverb to you among the sons of Israel, saying, 'The fathers ate unripe grapes, and the teeth of the children were set on edge'?
verses.18:3: As I live, says the Lord, never again will this proverb be spoken in Israel.
verses.18:4: For all souls are Mine; just as the soul of the father, so also the soul of the son—they are Mine; the soul that sins, that one will die.
verses.18:5: Now the man who will be righteous, who practices righteousness,
verses.18:6: will not eat upon the mountains, and will by no means lift up his eyes to the devices of the house of Israel, and will by no means defile the wife of his neighbor, and will not approach a woman who is in her menstrual period,
verses.18:7: and will by no means oppress any person, will return the pledge of a debtor and will not seize plunder, will give his bread to the hungry and will clothe the naked,
verses.18:8: and will not lend his money at interest and will not take increase, and will turn back his hand from unrighteousness, will execute righteous judgment between a man and his neighbor,
verses.18:9: and has walked in My statutes, has kept My ordinances to do them—this one is righteous; he will surely live, says the Lord.
verses.18:10: And if he fathers a pestilent son, who sheds blood and commits a sin—
verses.18:11: he did not walk in the way of his righteous father, but even ate upon the mountains and defiled the wife of his neighbor,
verses.18:12: and oppressed the poor and the needy, and seized plunder, and did not return a pledge, and set his eyes upon the idols; he has committed lawlessness,
verses.18:13: he lent with interest and took increase—this one will surely not live; he committed all these lawless deeds; he will surely be put to death; his blood will be upon him.
verses.18:14: Now if he fathers a son, and he sees all the sins of his father which he committed, and fears and does not act according to them—
verses.18:15: he has not eaten upon the mountains, and did not set his eyes upon the devices of the house of Israel, and did not defile the wife of his neighbor,
verses.18:16: and did not oppress any person, and did not take a pledge, and did not seize plunder, gave his bread to the hungry and clothed the naked,
verses.18:17: and turned back his hand from unrighteousness, took neither interest nor increase, practiced righteousness and walked in My statutes—he will not die in the unrighteous deeds of his father; he will surely live.
verses.18:18: As for his father, if he severely oppresses and seizes plunder—he did contrary things in the midst of My people, and he will die in his unrighteousness.
verses.18:19: And you will say, 'Why has the son not borne the unrighteousness of the father?' Because the son has practiced righteousness and mercy, has carefully kept all My laws and done them; he will surely live.
verses.18:20: Now the soul that sins will die; the son will not bear the unrighteousness of the father, nor will the father bear the unrighteousness of the son; the righteousness of a righteous one will be upon him, and the lawlessness of a lawless one will be upon him.
verses.18:21: And if the lawless one turns away from all his lawless deeds which he committed, and keeps all My commandments and practices righteousness and mercy, he will surely live; he will by no means die.
verses.18:22: All his trespasses, as many as he committed, will not be remembered; in his righteousness which he practiced he will live.
verses.18:23: Do I really desire the death of the lawless one, says the Lord, as much as that he should turn away from the evil way and live?
verses.18:24: But when a righteous one turns away from his righteousness and commits unrighteousness according to all the lawless deeds which the lawless one committed, all his righteous deeds which he practiced will by no means be remembered; in his trespass by which he trespassed and in his sins which he sinned, in them he will die.
verses.18:25: And you said, 'The way of the Lord is not straight.' Hear now, house of Israel: is My way not straight? Is it not your way that is not straight?
verses.18:26: When the righteous one turns away from his righteousness and commits a trespass, and dies in the trespass which he committed, in it he will die.
verses.18:27: And when a lawless one turns away from his lawlessness which he committed and practices judgment and righteousness, this one has preserved his soul.
verses.18:28: And he turned away from all his impieties which he committed; he will surely live; he will by no means die.
verses.18:29: And the house of Israel says, 'The way of the Lord is not upright.' Is My way not upright, house of Israel? Is it not your way that is not upright?
verses.18:30: Each one according to his way I will judge you, house of Israel, says the Lord; turn back and turn away from all your impieties, and they will not be to you for a punishment of unrighteousness.
verses.18:31: Cast away from yourselves all your impieties by which you acted impiously against Me, and make for yourselves a new heart and a new spirit; and why are you dying, house of Israel?
verses.18:32: For I do not desire the death of the one who dies, says the Lord."
verses.19:1: And you, take up a lamentation over the ruler of Israel,
verses.19:2: and you shall say, "What was your mother? A lion cub; in the midst of lions she came to be, in the midst of lions she multiplied her cubs.
verses.19:3: And one of her cubs leaped forth; he became a lion, and he learned to seize prey; he ate people.
verses.19:4: And nations heard against him; in their destruction he was captured, and they led him in a muzzle to the land of Egypt.
verses.19:5: And she saw that he had been driven away from her; her expectation perished; and she took another of her cubs; she appointed him a lion.
verses.19:6: And he moved about in the midst of lions; he became a lion, and he learned to seize prey; he ate people.
verses.19:7: And he fed in his boldness and laid waste their cities, and he ruined the land and its fullness at the sound of his roaring.
verses.19:8: And nations from regions all around set themselves against him, and they spread out their nets over him; in their destruction he was captured;
verses.19:9: and they put him in a muzzle and in a cage; he came to the king of Babylon, and he brought him into prison, so that his voice might not be heard upon the mountains of Israel.
verses.19:10: Your mother was like a vine and like a blossom on a pomegranate tree, planted in water; her fruit and her shoot came from much water.
verses.19:11: And she became a rod over a tribe of leaders, and she was exalted in her stature in the midst of trunks, and she saw her stature in the multitude of her branches.
verses.19:12: And she was broken down in wrath; to the ground she was cast, and the scorching wind dried up her choice parts; they were punished, and the rod of her strength was dried up; fire consumed her.
verses.19:13: And now they have planted her in the wilderness, in a waterless land.
verses.19:14: And fire went out from a rod of her choice parts and devoured her, and there was no rod of strength in her; a tribe is for a parable of lamentation, and it will be for a lamentation."
verses.20:1: And it happened in the seventh year, on the fifteenth of the month, that men from the elders of the house of Israel came to inquire of the Lord, and they sat before my face.
verses.20:2: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.20:3: "Son of man, speak to the elders of Israel, and you will say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Are you coming to inquire of Me? As I live, I will certainly not answer you, says the Lord,
verses.20:4: nor will I avenge them with vengeance.' Son of man, testify to them concerning the lawless deeds of their fathers,
verses.20:5: and you will say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: From the day I chose the house of Israel, I was made known to the seed of the house of Jacob, and I was known to them in the land of Egypt, and I took hold of them with My hand, saying, "I am the Lord your God."
verses.20:6: On that day I took hold of them with My hand to bring them out of the land of Egypt into the land that I prepared for them, a land flowing with milk and honey; it is a honeycomb beyond all the earth.
verses.20:7: And I said to them, "Let each one cast away the abominations of his eyes, and do not defile yourselves with the practices of Egypt; I am the Lord your God."
verses.20:8: And they turned away from Me, and they were not willing to listen to Me; they did not cast away the abominations of their eyes, and they did not forsake the practices of Egypt. And I said I would pour out My wrath upon them, to bring My anger to completion among them in the midst of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:9: And I acted so that My name might not be profaned at all in the sight of the nations in whose midst they are, among whom I was known to them in their sight by bringing them out of the land of Egypt.
verses.20:10: And I led them into the wilderness,
verses.20:11: and I gave them My ordinances, and I made My decrees known to them, all of which, if a person does them, he will live by them.
verses.20:12: And I gave them My Sabbaths to be a sign between Me and them, so that they might know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them.
verses.20:13: And I said to the house of Israel in the wilderness, "Walk in My ordinances." Yet they did not walk in them, and they rejected My decrees, which, if a person does them, he will live by them, and they greatly profaned My Sabbaths. And I said I would pour out My wrath upon them in the wilderness to consume them.
verses.20:14: And I acted so that My name might not be profaned at all in the sight of the nations before whose eyes I brought them out.
verses.20:15: I also lifted up My hand against them in the wilderness not to bring them at all into the land that I gave them, a land flowing with milk and honey; it is a honeycomb beyond all the earth—
verses.20:16: because they rejected My decrees, and they did not walk in My ordinances, and they were profaning My Sabbaths, and they were walking after the devices of their heart.
verses.20:17: Yet My eye spared them so as not to wipe them out, and I did not bring them to a complete end in the wilderness.
verses.20:18: And I said to their children in the wilderness, "Do not walk in the statutes of your fathers, and do not keep their decrees, and do not mingle with their practices and do not defile yourselves.
verses.20:19: I am the Lord your God; walk in My ordinances, and keep My decrees and do them,
verses.20:20: and sanctify My Sabbaths, and let them be a sign between Me and you, to know that I am the Lord your God."
verses.20:21: And their children also provoked Me; they did not walk in My ordinances, and they did not keep My decrees to do them, which, if a person does them, he will live by them, and they were profaning My Sabbaths. And I said I would pour out My wrath upon them in the wilderness to bring My anger to completion upon them.
verses.20:22: And I acted so that My name might not be profaned at all in the sight of the nations, and I brought them out before their eyes.
verses.20:23: And I lifted up My hand against them in the wilderness to scatter them among the nations, to disperse them in the countries,
verses.20:24: because they did not do My decrees, and they rejected My ordinances, and they were profaning My Sabbaths, and their eyes were after the devices of their fathers.
verses.20:25: I also gave them ordinances that were not good and decrees by which they will not live.
verses.20:26: And I will defile them by their gifts, when I pass through everything that opens a womb, so that I may destroy them.'
verses.20:27: Therefore speak to the house of Israel, son of man, and you will say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Up to this point your fathers provoked Me to anger by their trespasses in which they trespassed against Me.
verses.20:28: And I brought them into the land that I lifted My hand to give them, and they saw every high hill and every shady tree, and they sacrificed there to their gods, and they set there an aroma of sweet fragrance, and they poured out their drink offerings there.
verses.20:29: And I said to them, "What is Habana, that you go in there?" And they called its name Habana until this present day.'
verses.20:30: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'Thus says the Lord: Are you defiling yourselves in the lawless deeds of your fathers, and are you prostituting yourselves after their abominations?
verses.20:31: And in the firstfruits of your gifts, in the separated offerings by which you defile yourselves with all your devices until this present day? And should I answer you, house of Israel? As I live, says the Lord, I will certainly not answer you, nor will this come up upon your spirit.
verses.20:32: And it will not be as you say, "We will be like the nations and like the tribes of the earth, to worship wood and stones."
verses.20:33: Therefore, as I live, says the Lord, with a mighty hand and with a high arm and with poured-out wrath I will reign over you,
verses.20:34: and I will bring you out from the peoples, and I will receive you from the countries where you were scattered, with a mighty hand and a high arm and with poured-out wrath.
verses.20:35: And I will lead you into the wilderness of the peoples, and I will enter into judgment with you there face to face.
verses.20:36: Just as I entered into judgment with your fathers in the wilderness of the land of Egypt, so I will judge you, says the Lord.
verses.20:37: And I will lead you through under My rod, and I will bring you in by number,
verses.20:38: and I will convict from among you the ungodly and those who have turned away, because I will bring them out from their place of sojourning, and they will not enter into the land of Israel; and you will know that I am the Lord, the Lord.
verses.20:39: And you, house of Israel, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Each one remove his practices; and after these things, if you do not listen to Me, yet My holy name you will no longer profane with your gifts and with your practices,
verses.20:40: because on My holy mountain, on a high mountain, says the Lord, the Lord, there all the house of Israel will serve Me to the end. And there I will accept, and there I will attend to, your firstfruits and the firstfruits of your separated offerings with all your holy things.
verses.20:41: With an aroma of sweet fragrance I will accept you, when I bring you out from the peoples and receive you from the countries in which you were scattered, and I will be sanctified in you before the eyes of the peoples.
verses.20:42: And you will know that I am the Lord, when I bring you into the land of Israel, into the land that I lifted My hand to give to your fathers.
verses.20:43: And there you will remember your ways and your practices in which you were defiling yourselves, and you will beat your faces over all your evils.
verses.20:44: And you will know that I am the Lord, when I act in this way toward you so that My name may not be profaned according to your evil ways and according to your corrupted practices, says the Lord.'"
verses.21:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:2: "Son of man, set your face toward Teman and look toward Dagon, and prophesy against the leading forest of the Negev,
verses.21:3: and you shall say to the forest of the Negev, 'Hear the word of the Lord. Thus says the Lord, the Lord: "Look, I am kindling a fire in you, and it will devour in you a green tree and every dry tree; the flame that is kindled will not be quenched, and every face will be burned up in it, from the east to the north.
verses.21:4: And all flesh will know that I, the Lord, have kindled it; it will not be quenched."'"
verses.21:5: And I said, "By no means, Lord, Lord! They are saying to me, 'Is this not a parable being spoken?'"
verses.21:6: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:7: "Therefore prophesy, son of man; set your face toward Jerusalem and look toward their holy places, and you shall prophesy against the land of Israel.
verses.21:8: And you shall say to the land of Israel, 'Look, I am against you, and I will draw My dagger out of its sheath, and I will destroy from you the unrighteous and the lawless.
verses.21:9: Because I will destroy from you the unrighteous and the lawless, so My dagger will go out from its sheath against all flesh from the east to the north,
verses.21:10: and all flesh will know that I, the Lord, have drawn My dagger out of its sheath; it will not return anymore.'
verses.21:11: And you, son of man, groan deeply with the crushing of your loins, and in pains you shall groan before their eyes.
verses.21:12: And it will be, if they say to you, 'Why are you groaning?' then you shall say, 'Because of the report, for it is coming; and every heart will be broken, and all hands will be paralyzed, and all flesh and every spirit will faint, and all thighs will be defiled with moisture. Look, it is coming,'" says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.21:13: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:14: "Son of man, prophesy and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord.' Say, 'A sword, a sword, be sharpened and be enraged,
verses.21:15: so that you may slaughter victims; be sharpened so that you may come to a gleam, ready for paralysis; slaughter, despise, reject every tree.
verses.21:16: And he gave it ready for his hand to hold; the sword has been sharpened; it is ready to be given into the hand of a slayer.'
