verses.21:17: Cry out and wail, son of man, for it has come among My people, it is among all the leaders of Israel; they will sojourn; upon a sword it has come among My people; therefore clap upon your hand.
verses.21:18: For it has been justified; and should a tribe be rejected? It will not be," says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.21:19: "And you, son of man, prophesy and clap hand upon hand, and double the sword; the third is a sword of the wounded, the great sword of the wounded. And you will dismay them,
verses.21:20: so that the heart may not be broken, and the weak may be multiplied at every gate; they have been handed over as victims of the sword; it has been made well for slaughter, it has been made well for gleaming.
verses.21:21: Pass through, be sharpened on the right and on the left, wherever your face is roused.
verses.21:22: And I also will clap My hand to My hand and I will let loose My fury; I, the Lord, have spoken."
verses.21:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.21:24: "And you, son of man, mark out for yourself two roads for the sword of the king of Babylon to enter; out of one country the two will go forth. And a hand is at the head of a road to a city; at the head of the road you shall mark it out
verses.21:25: for a sword to enter against Rabbah of the sons of Ammon, and against Judea, and against Jerusalem, in its midst.
verses.21:26: For the king of Babylon will stand at the ancient road, at the head of the two roads, to practice divination: to shake a rod, and to inquire by the carved images, and to inspect the liver
verses.21:27: on his right. The divination came against Jerusalem: to throw up a palisade, to open the mouth with a shout, to lift up the voice with an outcry, to throw up a palisade against her gates, and to cast up a mound, and to build siege batteries.
verses.21:28: And he is to them like one practicing divination before them, and he is calling to mind his injustices to be remembered.
verses.21:29: Therefore thus says the Lord: 'Because you have called your injustices to mind in that your impieties were uncovered, so that your sins were seen in all your impieties and in your practices; because you have called them to mind, in these you will be captured.'
verses.21:30: And you, lawless, profane leader of Israel, whose day has come in the time of injustice, the end,
verses.21:31: thus says the Lord: 'You have taken off the turban and put on the crown; for her it will not be like this; you have humbled what is high, and you have exalted what is low.
verses.21:32: Injustice, injustice, injustice I will make her, woe to her! Such she will be until he comes to whom it belongs, and I will hand it over to him.'
verses.21:33: And you, son of man, prophesy and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord concerning the sons of Ammon and concerning their reproach.' And you shall say, 'A sword, a sword, drawn for slaughter and drawn for complete destruction; rouse yourself so that you may gleam,
verses.21:34: in your empty vision and in your divining falsehoods, to deliver you onto the necks of the lawless wounded, the day has come in the time of injustice, the end.
verses.21:35: Turn back; do not lodge in this place in which you were born; in your own land I will judge you.
verses.21:36: And I will pour out My wrath upon you; in the fire of My wrath I will blow upon you, and I will deliver you into the hands of barbarous men who craft destructions.
verses.21:37: In fire you will be food; your blood will be in the midst of your land; there will by no means be any remembrance of you, for I, the Lord, have spoken.'"
verses.22:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:2: "And you, son of man, will you judge the city of bloodshed? Then show her all her lawless deeds,
verses.22:3: and you shall say, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: "O city shedding blood in her midst so that her time may come, and making devices against herself to defile herself!
verses.22:4: By their blood that you have shed you have transgressed, and by your devices that you were making you defiled yourself; and you have brought your days near, and you have brought the time of your years. Therefore I have given you as a reproach to the nations and as a mockery to all the countries, those near to you
verses.22:5: and those far distant from you; and they will mock at you, you unclean one, renowned and abounding in lawless deeds!
verses.22:6: Look, the leaders of the house of Israel, each one with his relatives, mingled together in you so that they might shed blood.
verses.22:7: Father and mother they reviled in you, and toward a resident alien they conducted themselves with injustices in you; orphan and widow they oppressed;
verses.22:8: and My holy things they despised, and My Sabbaths they profaned in you.
verses.22:9: Men who are robbers are in you, so that they may shed blood in you; and on the mountains they ate in you; unholy deeds they practiced in your midst.
verses.22:10: The shame of a father they uncovered in you, and her who was set apart in her impurities they humbled in you.
verses.22:11: Each one acted lawlessly with the wife of his neighbor, and each one defiled his daughter-in-law in impiety, and each one humbled his sister, the daughter of his father, in you.
verses.22:12: Gifts they took in you in order to shed blood; interest and increase they took in you; and you brought to completion the full measure of your wickedness in oppression, but Me you have forgotten," says the Lord.
verses.22:13: "Now if I bring My hand against what you have completed that you have done, and against your bloodshed that has taken place in your midst,
verses.22:14: will your heart endure? Will your hands be strong in the days in which I act in you? I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will act.
verses.22:15: And I will scatter you among the nations, and I will disperse you among the countries, and your uncleanness will cease from you.
verses.22:16: And I will take possession in you before the eyes of the nations, and you will know that I am the Lord."'"
verses.22:17: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:18: "Son of man, look, the house of Israel has become to Me all mixed with bronze and iron and tin and lead; in the midst of silver it is mixed.
verses.22:19: Therefore say, 'Thus says the Lord: "Because you have become one mixture, therefore I am taking you into the midst of Jerusalem.
verses.22:20: Just as silver and bronze and iron and tin and lead are taken into the midst of a furnace, to blow fire onto it in order to be melted, so in My wrath I will take you in, and I will gather and melt you;
verses.22:21: and I will blow upon you in the fire of My wrath, and you will be melted in its midst.
verses.22:22: As silver is melted in the midst of a furnace, so you will be melted in its midst; and you will know that I, the Lord, have poured out My fury upon you."'"
verses.22:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.22:24: "Son of man, say to her, 'You are a land that is not watered, nor has rain come upon you in the day of wrath,
verses.22:25: whose leaders in her midst are like roaring lions seizing prey, devouring souls by force and taking valuables; and your widows have been multiplied in your midst.
verses.22:26: And her priests have set aside My law and profaned My holy things; between the holy and the profane they made no distinction, and between the unclean and the clean they made no distinction, and from My Sabbaths they covered their eyes, and I was profaned in their midst.
verses.22:27: Her rulers in her midst are like wolves seizing prey to shed blood, so that with greed they may make greedy gain.
verses.22:28: And her prophets, daubing them, will fall, seeing empty things, divining falsehoods, saying, "Thus says the Lord," when the Lord has not spoken;
verses.22:29: extorting the people of the land with injustice and carrying off plunder, oppressing the poor and the needy, and not conducting themselves with justice toward the resident alien.
verses.22:30: And I was seeking from among them a man conducting himself uprightly and standing completely before My face in the time of the land, so that I would not completely blot it out, and I found none.
verses.22:31: And I poured out My fury upon her in the fire of My wrath, to make an end; their ways I have put upon their heads,'" says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.23:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.23:2: "Son of man, there were two women, daughters of one mother,
verses.23:3: and they prostituted themselves in Egypt in their youth; there their breasts fell, there they were deflowered.
verses.23:4: And their names were Oholah the older and Oholibah her sister. And they became Mine, and they bore sons and daughters. And their names: Samaria was Oholah, and Jerusalem was Oholibah.
verses.23:5: And Oholah prostituted herself away from Me and threw herself upon her lovers, upon the Assyrians who were drawing near to her,
verses.23:6: clothed in blue-purple, rulers and commanders; young men and choice ones, all of them horsemen riding on horses.
verses.23:7: And she gave her prostitution to them—all of them choice sons of the Assyrians—and with all upon whom she threw herself, she was defiling herself with all her devices.
verses.23:8: And she did not abandon her prostitution from Egypt, because they lay with her in her youth, and they themselves deflowered her and poured out their prostitution upon her.
verses.23:9: Therefore I handed her over into the hands of her lovers, into the hands of the sons of the Assyrians, upon whom she was throwing herself.
verses.23:10: They uncovered her shame, took her sons and daughters, and killed her with a sword; and she became a subject of talk among women, and they executed punishments upon her for the daughters.
verses.23:11: And her sister Oholibah saw, and she corrupted her advances more than she did, and her prostitution more than the prostitution of her sister.
verses.23:12: She threw herself upon the sons of the Assyrians, rulers and commanders who were near her, clothed in finely bordered garments, horsemen riding on horses—all of them choice young men.
verses.23:13: And I saw that she was defiled; the two of them had one way.
verses.23:14: And she added to her prostitution, and she saw men painted on the wall, images of Chaldeans, painted with a stylus,
verses.23:15: girded with multicolored fabrics around their waists, dyed cloths also on their heads, a threefold appearance of all of them, a likeness of the sons of the Chaldeans, of the land of his homeland.
verses.23:16: And she threw herself upon them at the sight of her eyes, and she sent out messengers to them to the land of the Chaldeans.
verses.23:17: And the sons of Babylon came to her, into a bed of lodgers, and they were defiling her with her prostitution; and she was defiled by them, and her soul turned away from them.
verses.23:18: And she uncovered her prostitution, and she uncovered her shame; and My soul turned away from her, just as My soul had turned away from her sister.
verses.23:19: And you multiplied your prostitution to call to mind the day of your youth, in which you prostituted yourself in Egypt,
verses.23:20: and you threw yourself upon the Chaldeans, whose flesh is like that of donkeys, and their genitals are the genitals of horses,
verses.23:21: and you revisited the lawlessness of your youth, the things that you were doing in Egypt in your lodging, where the breasts of your youth were.
verses.23:22: Therefore, Oholibah, thus says the Lord: 'Look, I am rousing your lovers against you, from whom your soul turned away, and I will bring them against you from all around:
verses.23:23: the sons of Babylon and all the Chaldeans, Phakouk, Soue, and Hychoue, and all the sons of the Assyrians with them—choice young men, governors and commanders, all of them threefold and renowned, riding on horses.
verses.23:24: And they will all come against you from the north, chariots and wheels with a crowd of peoples, large shields and small shields, and he will set a guard against you all around.
verses.23:25: And I will set judgment before their face, and they will punish you by their judgments. And I will direct My jealousy against you, and they will deal with you in furious wrath; they will remove your nose and your ears, and they will strike down your survivors with a sword. They will take your sons and your daughters, and fire will devour your survivors.
verses.23:26: And they will strip you of your clothing, and they will take the articles of your boasting.
verses.23:27: And I will turn away your impieties from you and your prostitution from the land of Egypt, and you will by no means lift up your eyes to them, and you will never remember Egypt again.'
verses.23:28: For this is what the Lord, the Lord says: 'Look, I am handing you over into the hands of those whom you hate, from whom your soul turned away.
verses.23:29: And they will deal with you in hatred, and they will take all your labors and your toils, and you will be naked and shamed, and the shame of your prostitution and your impiety will be uncovered. And your prostitution
verses.23:30: did these things to you, in your prostituting yourself after nations, and you were defiling yourself with their devices.
verses.23:31: You walked in the way of your sister, and I will put her cup into your hands.'
verses.23:32: Thus says the Lord: 'You will drink the cup of your sister, the deep and wide and overflowing one, to bring drunkenness to completion,
verses.23:33: and you will be filled with exhaustion; and the cup of ruin is the cup of your sister, and you will drink it,
verses.23:34: and I will turn away her festivals and her new moons; because I have spoken,' says the Lord.
verses.23:35: Therefore, thus says the Lord: 'Because you have forgotten Me and cast Me behind your body, you too, bear your impiety and your prostitution.'"
verses.23:36: And the Lord said to me, "Son of man, will you not judge Oholah and Oholibah? And declare to them their lawless deeds,
verses.23:37: because they were committing adultery, and blood is on their hands; they were committing adultery with their devices, and their children whom they bore to Me they passed through sacrificial fires for them.
verses.23:38: Even these things too they did to Me: they were defiling My sanctuaries and profaning My Sabbaths,
verses.23:39: and when they were slaughtering their children to their idols, they were also entering My sanctuaries to profane them. And because they were acting in this way in the midst of My house,
verses.23:40: and because for the men coming from afar, to whom they were sending out messengers, as soon as they arrived you immediately bathed yourself and painted your eyes and adorned yourself with ornaments,
verses.23:41: and you sat on a spread couch, with a table arranged before it; and the incense and My oil—they were delighting in them,
verses.23:42: and they were striking up a sound of harmony, even for men from a multitude of people who had come from the wilderness; and they were putting bracelets on their hands and a crown of boasting on their heads.
verses.23:43: And I said, 'Are they not committing adultery in these things?' And with the deeds of a prostitute she herself also prostituted herself;
verses.23:44: and they were going in to her; just as they go in to a woman who is a prostitute, so they were going in to Oholah and to Oholibah to commit lawlessness.
verses.23:45: And righteous men—they themselves will indeed punish them with the punishment of an adulteress and with the punishment of blood, because they are adulteresses, and blood is on their hands.
verses.23:46: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: 'Bring up a crowd against them, and put turmoil and plunder among them,
verses.23:47: and stone them with the stones of crowds, and pierce them through with their swords; they will kill their sons and their daughters, and they will burn down their houses.
verses.23:48: And I will turn away impiety from the land, and all the women will be disciplined and will by no means act according to their impieties.
verses.23:49: And your impiety will be placed upon you, and you will bear the sins of your devices; and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.24:1: And the word of the Lord came to me in the ninth year, in the tenth month, on the tenth of the month, saying,
verses.24:2: "Son of man, write for yourself for a day from this day, from which the king of Babylon pressed against Jerusalem, from this very day;
verses.24:3: and speak a parable against the provoking house, and you will say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Set the cauldron on, and pour water into it,
verses.24:4: and throw into it the cut pieces, every good cut piece, thigh and shoulder, stripped from the bones,
verses.24:5: taken from choice livestock, and burn the bones underneath them. It boiled, and her bones have been cooked in her midst.
verses.24:6: Therefore thus says the Lord: O city of bloodshed, cauldron in which there is rust, and the rust did not go out from her; piece by piece of her she brought out; no lot fell upon her.
verses.24:7: For her bloodshed is in her midst; upon a smooth rock I have set it; I have not poured it out upon the earth to cover it with earth,
verses.24:8: so that wrath may rise up for vengeance, to be avenged; I have placed her blood upon a smooth rock, so as not to cover it.
verses.24:9: Therefore thus says the Lord: I also will make the people great,
verses.24:10: and I will multiply the wood and kindle the fire, so that the meat may melt away and the broth may be reduced
verses.24:11: and she may stand upon the coals, so that her bronze may be scorched and heated and melt in the midst of her uncleanness, and her rust may disappear,
verses.24:12: and her abundant rust will by no means go out from her; her rust will be put to shame,
verses.24:13: because you yourself were defiling yourself. And what if you are not cleansed any longer until I satisfy My wrath?
verses.24:14: I, the Lord, have spoken, and it will come, and I will act; I will not hold back nor will I ever have mercy. According to your ways and according to your devices I will judge you, says the Lord. Therefore I will judge you according to your bloodshed, and according to your devices I will judge you, unclean one, renowned and great in provoking.'"
verses.24:15: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.24:16: "Son of man, look, I am taking from you the desires of your eyes in battle; you shall by no means lament, nor shall you weep.
verses.24:17: You will be a groaning of blood, of loins, of mourning; your hair will not be braided upon you, and your sandals will be on your feet; you shall by no means be comforted by their lips, and you shall by no means eat the bread of men."
verses.24:18: And I spoke to the people in the morning just as He commanded me in the evening, and I did in the morning just as it was ordered to me.
verses.24:19: And the people said to me, "Will you not tell us what these things are that you are doing?"
verses.24:20: And I said to them, "The word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.24:21: 'Say to the house of Israel, Thus says the Lord: Look, I am profaning My sanctuary, the pride of your strength, the desires of your eyes, and the things for which your souls feel pity. And your sons and your daughters whom you left behind will fall by the sword,
verses.24:22: and you will do just as I have done: you will not be comforted by their mouth, and you will not eat the bread of men,
verses.24:23: and your hair will be upon your head, and your sandals on your feet; you will neither lament nor weep, and you will melt away in your iniquities, and each one will comfort his brother.
verses.24:24: And Ezekiel will be a portent to you; according to all that you have done you will do when these things come; and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.24:25: "And you, son of man, will it not be on the day when I take the strength from them, the lifting up of their boasting, the desires of their eyes and the lifting up of their soul, their sons and their daughters,
verses.24:26: on that day the survivor will come to you to report to you in your ears?
verses.24:27: On that day your mouth will be opened to the survivor; you will speak, and you will never again be mute, and you will be a portent to them; and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.25:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.25:2: "Son of man, set your face against the sons of Ammon and prophesy against them,
verses.25:3: and you will say to the sons of Ammon, 'Hear the word of the Lord! Thus says the Lord: Because you gloated over My sanctuary that it was profaned, and over the land of Israel that it was laid waste, and over the house of Judah that they went into captivity,
verses.25:4: therefore, look, I am handing you over to the sons of Kedem for an inheritance, and they will encamp with their gear in you, and they will set their tents in you; they themselves will eat your fruits, and they themselves will drink your fatness.
verses.25:5: And I will make the city of Ammon into pastures for camels, and the sons of Ammon into a pasture for sheep; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.25:6: For thus says the Lord: Because you clapped your hand and stamped with your foot, and gloated from your soul over the land of Israel,
verses.25:7: therefore I will stretch out My hand against you and give you for plunder among the nations, and I will exterminate you from the peoples, and I will destroy you from the lands with destruction; and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.25:8: Thus says the Lord: "Because Moab said, 'Look, is not the house of Israel and Judah just like all the nations?'
verses.25:9: therefore, look, I am paralyzing the shoulder of Moab from his frontier cities, a choice land, the house of Thasimouth, of the ascent of a coastal city,
verses.25:10: the sons of Kedem against the sons of Ammon; I have given it to him for an inheritance, so that there may be no remembrance of the sons of Ammon.
verses.25:11: And against Moab I will execute vengeance, and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.25:12: Thus says the Lord: "Because Idumea acted in taking vengeance against the house of Judah, and they held a grudge and exacted retribution,
verses.25:13: therefore thus says the Lord: I will also stretch out My hand against Idumea, and I will exterminate from her man and beast, and I will make her desolate, and those pursued from Teman will fall by the sword;
verses.25:14: and I will lay My vengeance upon Idumea by the hand of My people Israel, and they will act in Idumea according to My anger and according to My wrath; and they will know My vengeance," says the Lord.
verses.25:15: Therefore thus says the Lord: "Because the foreigners acted in vengeance and raised up vengeance, gloating from the soul to wipe out down to the last one,
verses.25:16: therefore thus says the Lord: Look, I will stretch out My hand against the foreigners, and I will exterminate the Cretans, and I will destroy the remnant who inhabit the seacoast;
verses.25:17: and I will execute great acts of vengeance among them, and they will know that I am the Lord, when I lay My vengeance upon them."
verses.26:1: And it happened in the eleventh year, on the first of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.26:2: "Son of man, because Tyre said against Jerusalem, 'Aha! She has been shattered; the nations have perished; she has turned to me; she who was full has been laid desolate!'
verses.26:3: therefore thus says the Lord: Look, I am against you, Tyre, and I will bring up many nations against you, as the sea rises up with its waves.
verses.26:4: And they will throw down the walls of Tyre, and they will throw down your towers, and I will winnow her dust from her, and I will make her into a smooth rock;
verses.26:5: she will be a drying place for dragnets in the midst of the sea, for I have spoken, says the Lord. And she will be for plunder to the nations,
verses.26:6: and her daughters in the plain will be killed by the sword; and they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.26:7: For thus says the Lord: Look, I am bringing against you, Tyre, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon from the north; he is king of kings, with horses and chariots and horsemen and an assembly of very many nations.
verses.26:8: He will kill your daughters who are in the plain by the sword, and he will set an outpost against you and build around you, and he will make a palisade all around against you and a ring of weapons, and he will set his spears opposite you;
verses.26:9: your walls and your towers he will throw down with his swords.
verses.26:10: From the multitude of his horses their dust will cover you, and from the sound of his horsemen and of the wheels of his chariots your walls will shake, as he enters your gates like one entering a city from a plain.
verses.26:11: With the hooves of his horses they will trample all your streets; he will kill your people with the sword, and he will bring down the foundation of your strength to the ground.
verses.26:12: And he will plunder your wealth, and he will loot your possessions, and he will throw down your walls and tear down your desirable houses, and your stones and your timber and your dust he will throw into the midst of your sea.
verses.26:13: And he will put an end to the multitude of your musicians, and the sound of your harps will by no means be heard any longer.
verses.26:14: And I will make you a smooth rock; you will be a drying place for dragnets; you will never be built again, for I, the Lord, have spoken, says the Lord.
verses.26:15: For thus says the Lord, the Lord, to Tyre: At the sound of your fall, when the wounded groan, when a sword is drawn in your midst, will not the islands shake?
verses.26:16: And all the rulers from the nations of the sea will come down from their thrones, and they will remove the turbans from their heads, and they will strip off their embroidered clothing; with dismay they will be dismayed, they will sit upon the ground and fear their destruction, and they will groan over you;
verses.26:17: and they will take up a lamentation over you and say to you, 'How have you been destroyed from the sea, the praised city, who put her terror on all who inhabit her?'
verses.26:18: And the islands will be afraid from the day of your fall.
verses.26:19: For thus says the Lord, the Lord: When I make you a desolated city, like the cities that will not be inhabited, when I bring up the abyss upon you, and much water covers you,
verses.26:20: then I will bring you down to those who go down to the pit, to a people of old, and I will make you dwell in the depths of the earth, like an eternal desolation, with those who go down to the pit, so that you may not be inhabited nor rise up upon the land of life.
verses.26:21: I will make you a destruction, and you will exist no longer forever, says the Lord, the Lord."
verses.27:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.27:2: "Son of man, you too, take up a lamentation over Tyre,
verses.27:3: and you shall say to Tyre, who dwells at the entrance of the sea, the trading center of the peoples from many islands, 'Thus says the Lord to Tyre:
verses.27:4: You said, "I have placed my beauty around myself." In the heart of the sea, for Beelim, your sons placed beauty around you.
verses.27:5: Cedar from Senir was built for you; strips of cypress planks from Lebanon were taken to make fir masts for you;
verses.27:6: from Bashan they made your oars; your sanctuaries they made of ivory, wooded houses from the islands of Kittim.
verses.27:7: Fine linen with embroidery from Egypt became bedding for you, to place glory around you and to clothe you with blue and purple from the islands of Elishah, and they became your coverings.
verses.27:8: And your rulers who dwell in Sidon and the Arvadites became your rowers; your wise men, Tyre, who were in you, these were your helmsmen;
verses.27:9: the elders of Byblos and their wise men were in you; these were strengthening your counsel; and all the ships of the sea and their rowers were yours to the west of the west.
verses.27:10: Persians and Lydians and Libyans were in your force; your fighting men hung shields and helmets in you; these gave your glory.
verses.27:11: The sons of the Arvadites and your force were on your walls; guards were in your towers; they hung their quivers on your anchorages all around; these perfected your beauty.
verses.27:12: The Carthaginians were your merchants from the abundance of all your strength; silver and gold and iron and tin and lead they gave for your market.
verses.27:13: Greece, and the whole world, and the bordering regions, these traded with you in human lives, and bronze vessels they gave for your trade;
verses.27:14: from the house of Togarmah, horses and horsemen supplied your market.
verses.27:15: Sons of the Rhodians were merchants; from the islands they multiplied your trade with ivory tusks, and for the things brought in you gave your wages in return;
verses.27:16: human beings as your trade from the abundance of your mixed wares, oil of myrrh and embroideries from Tarshish; and Lamoth and Chorchor supplied your market.
verses.27:17: Judah and the sons of Israel, these were your merchants in the sale of wheat and perfumes, and cassia; and finest honey and oil and resin they gave into your mixed wares.
verses.27:18: Damascus was your merchant from the abundance of all your power; wine from Helbon and wool from Miletus, and wine they gave into your market.
verses.27:19: From Asel is worked iron, and a wheel is in your mixed wares.
verses.27:20: Dedan were your merchants with choice beasts for chariots.
verses.27:21: Arabia and all the rulers of Kedar, these were your merchants by your hand: camels and rams and lambs, in which they trade with you.
verses.27:22: The merchants of Sheba and Raamah, these were your merchants with the finest spices and precious stones, and gold they gave for your market.
verses.27:23: Haran and Canneh, these were your merchants.
verses.27:24: Asshur and Charman were your merchants, bringing blue cloth as trade, and choice treasures bound with cords, and cypress wood.
verses.27:25: Ships were your merchants in the abundance, in your mixed wares; and you were filled and exceedingly weighed down in the heart of the sea.
verses.27:26: In much water your rowers led you. The south wind shattered you in the heart of the sea.
verses.27:27: There were your forces, and your wage and that of your mixed wares, and your rowers and your helmsmen and your counselors, and your mixed people from your mixed wares, and all your fighting men who are in you; and all your assembly in the midst of you will fall in the heart of the sea in the day of your fall.
verses.27:28: At the cry of your voice, your helmsmen will be terrified with fear,
verses.27:29: and all the rowers and the passengers will go down from the ships, and the lookouts of the sea will stand on the land,
verses.27:30: and they will wail over you with their voice and cry out bitterly, and they will put earth on their head and spread ashes for themselves.
verses.27:32: And their sons will take up a lamentation over you, a lament for Tyre.
verses.27:33: How great a wage did you find from the sea? You filled nations from your abundance, and from your mixed wares you enriched all the kings of the earth.
verses.27:34: Now you were shattered in the sea; in the depth of the water are your mixed wares, and all your assembly is in the midst of you; all your rowers fell.
verses.27:35: All those who dwell in the islands grew gloomy over you, and their kings were astounded with astonishment, and their face shed tears.
verses.27:36: Merchants from the nations hissed at you; you became destruction, and you will be no more forever.'"
verses.28:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.28:2: "And you, son of man, say to the ruler of Tyre, 'Thus says the Lord: Because your heart was lifted up, and you said, "I am a god; I have dwelt in the dwelling of a god in the heart of the sea," yet you are a man and not a god, and you set your heart like the heart of a god,
verses.28:3: are you really wiser than Daniel? Did wise men not instruct you with their knowledge?
verses.28:4: Did you really, by your knowledge or your understanding, make power for yourself, and gold and silver in your treasuries?
verses.28:5: By your great knowledge and trade you multiplied your power; your heart was lifted up in your power.
verses.28:6: Therefore, thus says the Lord: Since you have set your heart like the heart of a god,
verses.28:7: for this reason, look, I am bringing against you foreigners, pestilent ones from the nations, and they will draw out their swords against you and against the beauty of your knowledge, and they will lay your beauty low to destruction,
verses.28:8: and they will bring you down, and you will die the death of the wounded in the heart of the sea.
verses.28:9: Will you really say, "I am a god," before those who are killing you? Yet you are a man and not a god.
verses.28:10: Among a multitude of the uncircumcised you will perish by the hands of foreigners, for I have spoken, says the Lord.'"
verses.28:11: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.28:12: "Son of man, take up a lamentation over the ruler of Tyre and say to him, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: You, a seal of likeness
verses.28:13: and a crown of beauty, were in the delight of the paradise of God. You have bound on yourself every precious stone: sardius and topaz and emerald, and ruby and sapphire and jasper, and silver and gold, and jacinth and agate and amethyst, and chrysolite and beryl and onyx; and with gold you filled your treasuries and your storehouses in you.
verses.28:14: From the day you were created with the cherub, I placed you on the holy mountain of God; you were in the midst of fiery stones,
verses.28:15: you were blameless in your days, from the day you were created until the wrongdoings were found in you.
verses.28:16: From the abundance of your trade you filled your inner chambers with lawlessness, and you sinned and were wounded from the mountain of God, and the cherub led you out from the midst of fiery stones.
verses.28:17: Your heart was lifted up because of your beauty; your knowledge was corrupted with your beauty; because of the multitude of your sins I cast you to the ground; before kings I gave you to be made a public example.
verses.28:18: Because of the multitude of your sins and the injustices of your trade, I profaned your sanctuaries, and I will bring out fire from the midst of you; this will devour you; and I will make you ashes upon your land before all who see you.
verses.28:19: And all who know you among the nations will groan over you; you became destruction, and you will exist no longer forever.'"
verses.28:20: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.28:21: "Son of man, set your face toward Sidon and prophesy against her,
verses.28:22: and say, 'Thus says the Lord: Look, I am against you, Sidon, and I will be glorified in you, and you will know that I am the Lord when I execute judgments in you, and I will be sanctified in you.
verses.28:23: Blood and death will be in your streets, and those wounded by swords will fall in you all around you; and they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.28:24: And there will no longer be in the house of Israel a brier of bitterness and a thorn of pain from those all around them who dishonored them; and they will know that I am the Lord.
verses.28:25: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: And I will gather Israel from the nations where they were scattered, and I will be sanctified in them and before the peoples and the nations.
verses.28:26: And they will dwell upon their land, which I have given to My servant Jacob; and they will dwell upon it in hope, and they will build houses and plant vineyards, and they will dwell in hope, when I execute judgment among all those who dishonored them, among those around them; and they will know that I am the Lord their God and the God of their fathers.'"
verses.29:1: In the twelfth year, in the tenth month, on the first day of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.29:2: "Son of man, set your face against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and prophesy against him and against all Egypt,
verses.29:3: and say, 'Thus says the Lord: Look, I am against Pharaoh, the great dragon who sits in the midst of his rivers, who says, "Mine are the rivers, and I made them."
verses.29:4: And I will put snares into your jaws, and I will make the fish of your river cling to your fins, and I will bring you up from the midst of your river,
verses.29:5: and I will cast you down quickly, and all the fish of your river. On the face of the plain you will fall, and you will by no means be gathered and by no means be prepared for burial; to the wild beasts of the earth and to the birds of the sky I have given you for food.
verses.29:6: And all those who inhabit Egypt will know that I am the Lord, because you became a reed staff to the house of Israel.
verses.29:7: Because they took hold of you with their hand, you were crushed; and when every hand clapped against them, and when they leaned upon you, you were shattered, and you broke every loin of theirs.
verses.29:8: Therefore, thus says the Lord: Look, I am bringing a sword upon you, and I will destroy people and beasts from you,
verses.29:9: and the land of Egypt will become destruction and a wasteland; and they will know that I am the Lord, because you say, "The rivers are mine, and I made them."
verses.29:10: Therefore, look, I am against you and against all your rivers, and I will give the land of Egypt over to wasteland, sword, and destruction, from Migdol and Syene even to the borders of the Ethiopians.
verses.29:11: The foot of a person will by no means pass through it, and the foot of a beast will by no means pass through it, and it will not be inhabited for forty years.
verses.29:12: And I will make its land a destruction in the midst of a desolated land, and its cities will be in the midst of desolated cities for forty years. And I will scatter Egypt among the nations, and I will winnow them into the countries.
verses.29:13: Thus says the Lord: After forty years I will gather the Egyptians from the nations where they were dispersed,
verses.29:14: and I will turn back the captivity of the Egyptians, and I will settle them in the land of Pathros, in the land from which they were taken; and it will be a lowly dominion
verses.29:15: compared to all the dominions; it will by no means be exalted any longer over the nations, and I will make them few in number so that they will not be more numerous among the nations.
verses.29:16: And they will no longer be a hope for the house of Israel, bringing lawlessness to mind when they follow after them; and they will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.29:17: And it happened in the twenty-seventh year, on the first day of the first month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.29:18: "Son of man, Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon subjected his army to great servitude against Tyre; every head was bald, and every shoulder was rubbed bare; yet no wages came to him or to his army against Tyre, nor for the servitude with which they served against it.
verses.29:19: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Look, I am giving the land of Egypt to Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon, and he will plunder its plunder and despoil its spoils, and it will be wages for his army.
verses.29:20: In return for his service with which he served against Tyre, I have given him the land of Egypt. Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.29:21: In that day a horn will spring up for all the house of Israel, and to you I will give an opened mouth in their midst, and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.30:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.30:2: "Son of man, prophesy and say, 'Thus says the Lord: Alas, alas, the day,
verses.30:3: for a day is near, the day of the Lord; it will be the end of nations.
verses.30:4: And a sword will come upon the Egyptians, and there will be turmoil in the land of Ethiopia, and the wounded will collapse in Egypt, and its foundations will collapse.
verses.30:5: Persians and Cretans and Lydians and Libyans and all the mixed peoples, and some of the sons of My covenant, will fall by the sword in it.
verses.30:6: And the supports of Egypt will fall, and the arrogance of its strength will come down from Migdol to Syene; they will fall by the sword in it, says the Lord.
verses.30:7: And it will be desolated in the midst of desolated countries, and their cities will be in the midst of desolated cities.
verses.30:8: And they will know that I am the Lord, when I put fire upon Egypt and all those who help it are shattered.
verses.30:9: In that day messengers will go out hurrying to wipe out Ethiopia, and there will be turmoil among them in the day of Egypt, for look, it is coming.
verses.30:10: This is what the Lord, the Lord says: And I will destroy the multitude of the Egyptians by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon,
verses.30:11: him and his people, pestilent ones from the nations sent to destroy the land; and they will all unsheathe their swords against Egypt, and the land will be filled with the wounded.
verses.30:12: And I will make their rivers desolate and destroy the land and its fullness by the hands of foreigners; I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.30:13: For this is what the Lord, the Lord says: And I will destroy nobles from Memphis and rulers of Memphis from the land of Egypt, and they will be no more.
verses.30:14: And I will destroy the land of Pathros, and I will put fire upon Tanis, and I will execute vengeance in Diospolis.
verses.30:15: And I will pour out My wrath upon Sais, the strength of Egypt, and I will destroy the multitude of Memphis.
verses.30:16: And I will put fire upon Egypt, and Syene will be troubled with turmoil, and in Diospolis there will be a breach, and waters will be poured out.
verses.30:17: The young men of Heliopolis and Bubastis will fall by the sword, and the women will go into captivity,
verses.30:18: and in Tahpanhes the day will grow dark, when I shatter the scepters of Egypt there, and the arrogance of its strength will perish there; and a cloud will cover it, and its daughters will be led away captive.
verses.30:19: And I will execute judgment in Egypt, and they will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.30:20: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the first month, on the seventh day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.30:21: "Son of man, I have shattered the arms of Pharaoh king of Egypt, and look, he was not bound up to be given healing, to have a poultice put on him, to be given strength to take hold of a sword.
verses.30:22: Therefore, this is what the Lord, the Lord says: Look, I am against Pharaoh king of Egypt, and I will shatter his arms, the strong ones and the outstretched ones, and I will cast his sword down from his hand.
verses.30:23: And I will scatter Egypt into the nations and winnow them into the countries,
verses.30:24: and I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon and put My sword into his hand, and he will bring it upon Egypt and he will plunder its plunder and despoil its spoils.
verses.30:25: And I will strengthen the arms of the king of Babylon; the arms of Pharaoh will fall. And they will know that I am the Lord, when I put My sword into the hands of the king of Babylon, and he will stretch it out against the land of Egypt.
verses.30:26: And I will scatter Egypt into the nations, and winnow them into the countries; and all will know that I am the Lord."
verses.31:1: And it happened in the eleventh year, in the third month, on the first day of the month, that the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.31:2: "Son of man, say to Pharaoh king of Egypt and to his multitude, 'To whom have you compared yourself in your height?
verses.31:3: Look, Assyria was a cypress in Lebanon, beautiful in its boughs and tall in stature; its top reached into the midst of clouds.
verses.31:4: Water nourished it; the abyss exalted it; it led its own rivers around its plants, and sent out its channels to all the trees of the plain.
verses.31:5: Because of this its stature was exalted above all the trees of the plain, and its branches spread wide from much water.
verses.31:6: In its boughs all the birds of the sky nested, and underneath its branches all the wild beasts of the plain gave birth; in its shadow lived every multitude of nations.
verses.31:7: And it became beautiful in its height because of the multitude of its branches, for its roots reached into much water.
verses.31:8: And such cypresses were in the paradise of God, and the pines were not like its boughs, and firs did not become like its branches; no tree in the paradise of God became like it in its beauty
verses.31:9: because of the multitude of its branches, and the trees of the paradise of the delight of God envied it.
verses.31:10: Therefore, thus says the Lord: Because you became great in stature and put your top into the midst of clouds, and I saw when it was exalted,
verses.31:11: I handed it over into the hands of a ruler of nations, and he carried out its destruction,
verses.31:12: and pestilent foreigners from the nations utterly destroyed it and cast it down upon the mountains; in all the ravines its branches fell, and its limbs were shattered on every plain of the earth, and all the peoples of the nations came down from their shelter and dashed it to the ground.
verses.31:13: Upon its ruin all the birds of the sky rested, and upon its limbs were all the wild beasts of the field,
verses.31:14: so that even all the trees that are in the water might not be exalted in their stature; and they put their top into the midst of clouds, and they did not stand in their height beside them. All those who drink water, all have been given over to death, to the depth of the earth, in the midst of the sons of men, to those going down into the pit.
verses.31:15: This is what the Lord, the Lord says: On the day it went down to Hades, the abyss mourned for it, and I held back its rivers and restrained an abundance of water, and Lebanon grew dark over it; all the trees of the plain fainted over it.
verses.31:16: At the sound of its fall the nations shook, when I brought it down to Hades with those going down into the pit, and all the trees of delight and the choice ones of Lebanon, all those drinking water, comforted it in the earth.
verses.31:17: For they also went down with it to Hades among those wounded by the sword, and its seed, those who live under its shelter, perished in the midst of their life.
verses.31:18: To whom have you been compared? Go down and be brought down with the trees of delight to the depth of the earth; in the midst of the uncircumcised you will lie down with those wounded by the sword. So it is with Pharaoh and the multitude of his strength, says the Lord, the Lord.'"
verses.32:1: And it happened in the twelfth year, in the tenth month, on the first of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.32:2: "Son of man, take up a lament over Pharaoh king of Egypt, and you shall say to him, 'You have been likened to a lion of the nations, and like a dragon that is in the sea; and you were butting in your rivers, and troubling water with your feet, and trampling your rivers.
verses.32:3: Thus says the Lord: And I will cast over you nets of many peoples, and I will bring you up with My hook,
verses.32:4: and I will stretch you out upon the ground; plains shall be filled with you, and I will cause all the birds to settle upon you, and I will fill all the wild beasts of all the earth;
verses.32:5: and I will place your flesh upon the mountains, and I will fill them with your blood;
verses.32:6: and the land shall be watered with your discharges, from your multitude upon the mountains; ravines I will fill with you.
verses.32:7: And when you are extinguished, I will cover over heaven and darken its stars; the sun I will cover with a cloud, and the moon shall not shine its light.
verses.32:8: All the things shining light in heaven shall grow dark over you, and I will put darkness upon the earth, says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.32:9: And I will provoke to anger the heart of many peoples, when I bring your captivity to the nations, into a land that you did not know.
verses.32:10: And many nations shall be appalled over you, and their kings shall be astounded with astonishment when My sword flies before their faces, awaiting their fall from the day of your fall.
verses.32:11: For thus says the Lord: The sword of the king of Babylon shall come upon you
verses.32:12: with swords of giants, and I will cast down your strength; all of them are pestilent ones from the nations, and they shall destroy the arrogance of Egypt, and all her strength shall be shattered.
verses.32:13: And I will destroy all her livestock from much water, and the foot of man shall no longer trouble it, and the tread of livestock shall not trample it.
verses.32:14: Thus then their waters shall be calm, and their rivers shall run like oil, says the Lord.
verses.32:15: When I give Egypt over to destruction and the land is made desolate along with its fullness, when I scatter all those dwelling in it, then they shall know that I am the Lord.'
verses.32:16: It is a lament, and you shall lament it, and the daughters of the nations shall lament it; over Egypt and over all her strength they shall lament her, says the Lord, the Lord."
verses.32:17: And it happened in the twelfth year, in the first month, on the fifteenth of the month, the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.32:18: "Son of man, lament over the strength of Egypt, and the nations shall bring her daughters down dead into the depth of the earth, to those going down into the pit.
verses.32:20: In the midst of those wounded by the sword they shall fall with him, and all his strength shall lie down.
verses.32:21: And the giants shall say to you, 'Be in the depth of tumult! Than whom are you better? And go down and lie with the uncircumcised in the midst of those wounded by the sword.'
verses.32:22: There is Assyria and all its assembly; all of them wounded, there they were placed, and their burial is in the depth of the pit, and its assembly came to be around its tomb, all the wounded who have fallen by the sword,
verses.32:23: who laid their terror upon the land of life.
verses.32:24: There is Elam and all its force around its tomb, all the wounded who have fallen by the sword and those going down uncircumcised into the depth of the earth, who had laid their terror upon life; and they received their torment with those going down into the pit
verses.32:25: in the midst of the wounded.
verses.32:26: There Meshech and Tubal and all their strength were placed around its tomb, all its wounded, all uncircumcised, wounded by the sword, who had laid their terror upon life;
verses.32:27: and they lay down with the giants who have fallen from ancient times, who went down to Hades with weapons of war and placed their swords under their heads; and their lawless deeds came to be upon their bones, because they terrified everyone in their life.
verses.32:28: And you shall lie down in the midst of the uncircumcised with those who have been wounded by the sword.
verses.32:29: There the rulers of Assyria were placed, who gave its strength to the wound of the sword; these lay down with the wounded, with those going down into the pit.
verses.32:30: There are the rulers of the north, all the commanders of Assyria, who go down wounded; with their terror and their strength they lay down uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword, and they bore their torment with those going down into the pit.
verses.32:31: King Pharaoh shall see them, and he shall be comforted over all their strength, says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.32:32: For I have laid his terror upon life, and he shall lie down in the midst of the uncircumcised with those wounded by the sword, Pharaoh and all his multitude with him, says the Lord, the Lord."
verses.33:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.33:2: "Son of man, speak to the sons of your people and you shall say to them, 'As for a land upon which I may bring a sword, if the people of the land take one man from among them and set him for themselves as a watchman,
verses.33:3: and he sees the sword coming upon the land and blows the trumpet and signals to the people,
verses.33:4: and a hearer hears the sound of the trumpet and does not guard himself, and the sword comes and overtakes him, his blood shall be upon his head.
verses.33:5: Because he heard the sound of the trumpet and did not guard himself, his blood shall be upon him; whereas this one, because he guarded himself, delivered his soul.
verses.33:6: But if the watchman sees the sword coming and does not signal with the trumpet, and the people do not guard themselves, and the sword comes and takes a soul from among them, that soul was taken because of its own lawlessness, yet the blood I will require from the hand of the watchman.'
verses.33:7: And you, son of man, I have set you as a watchman for the house of Israel, and you shall hear a word from My mouth.
verses.33:8: When I say to the sinner, 'You shall surely be put to death,' and you do not speak so that the ungodly one may guard himself from his way, that lawless one shall die in his lawlessness, but his blood I will require from your hand.
verses.33:9: But if you forewarn the ungodly one of his way, to turn back from it, and he does not turn back from his way, that one shall die in his ungodliness, and you have delivered your own soul.
verses.33:10: And you, son of man, say to the house of Israel, 'Thus you have spoken, saying, "Our errors and our lawless deeds are upon us, and in them we are wasting away; and how shall we live?"'
verses.33:11: Say to them, 'As I live, thus says the Lord, I do not desire the death of the ungodly one, as much as that the ungodly one turn back from his way and live. Turn back completely from your way! And why are you dying, house of Israel?'
verses.33:12: Say to the sons of your people, 'The righteousness of a righteous one shall by no means deliver him on whatever day he errs, and the lawlessness of an ungodly one shall by no means harm him on whatever day he turns back from his lawlessness; and a righteous one shall by no means be able to be saved.
verses.33:13: When I say to the righteous one, "This one has trusted in his righteousness," and he does lawlessness, all his righteous deeds shall by no means be remembered; in his unrighteousness that he has done, in it he shall die.
verses.33:14: And when I say to the ungodly one, "You shall surely be put to death," and he turns back from his sin and does justice and righteousness,
verses.33:15: and returns a pledge and pays back things taken by robbery, walks in ordinances of life so as not to do what is unrighteous, he shall surely live and shall by no means die;
verses.33:16: all his sins that he has sinned shall by no means be remembered; because he has done justice and righteousness, in them he shall live.'
verses.33:17: Yet the sons of your people will say, 'The way of the Lord is not straight.' Yet this way of theirs is not straight.
verses.33:18: When a righteous one turns back from his righteousness and does lawless deeds, then he shall die in them.
verses.33:19: And when the sinner turns back from his lawlessness and does justice and righteousness, in them he himself shall live.
verses.33:20: And this is what you have said: 'The way of the Lord is not straight.' I will judge you, each one in his ways, house of Israel."
verses.33:21: And it happened in the twelfth year, in the twelfth month, on the fifth of the month, of our captivity, the one who had escaped came to me from Jerusalem, saying, "The city has been captured!"
verses.33:22: Now the hand of the Lord had come upon me in the evening before he came, and He opened my mouth until he came to me in the morning; and when my mouth was opened, it was no longer held shut.
verses.33:23: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.33:24: "Son of man, those who dwell in the desolate places on the land of Israel are saying, 'Abraham was one, and he possessed the land; yet we are more—to us the land has been given as a possession.'
verses.33:25: Therefore say to them, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.33:27: As I live, surely those who are in the desolate places shall fall by swords, and those who are on the face of the plain shall be given to the wild beasts of the field for food, and those in the fortified places and those in the caves I will kill with death.
verses.33:28: And I will render the land desolate, and the arrogance of its strength shall perish, and the mountains of Israel shall be made desolate because there is no one passing through.
verses.33:29: And they shall know that I am the Lord; and I will make their land desolate, and it shall be made desolate because of all their abominations that they have done.'
verses.33:30: And you, son of man, the sons of your people who speak about you by the walls and in the gateways of the houses—they speak, one to his brother, saying, 'Let us come together and hear the things going forth from the Lord.'
verses.33:31: They come to you as a people comes together, and they sit before you and hear your words, yet they will by no means do them; for falsehood is in their mouth, and their heart is after defilements.
verses.33:32: And you become to them like the sound of a sweet-voiced, harmonious harp, and they will hear your words, yet they will by no means do them.
verses.33:33: And when it comes, they will say, 'Look, it has come!' and they shall know that a prophet was in their midst."
verses.34:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.34:2: "Son of man, prophesy against the shepherds of Israel; prophesy and say to the shepherds, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: O shepherds of Israel, do shepherds feed themselves? Do the shepherds not feed the sheep?
verses.34:3: Look, you consume the milk and clothe yourselves with the wool and slaughter the fat one, yet you do not feed My sheep.
verses.34:4: The weak you did not strengthen, and the sick you did not restore to health, and the broken you did not bind up, and the straying you did not bring back, and the lost you did not seek, and the strong you wore down with toil.
verses.34:5: And My sheep were scattered because there were no shepherds, and they became food for all the wild beasts of the field.
verses.34:6: And My sheep were scattered on every mountain and upon every high hill, and over the face of the earth they were scattered, and there was no one seeking them out nor anyone bringing them back.
verses.34:7: Therefore, shepherds, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.34:8: As I live, says the Lord, the Lord, surely because My sheep became plunder, and My sheep became food for all the wild beasts of the plain since there were no shepherds, and the shepherds did not seek out My sheep, and the shepherds fed themselves, while My sheep they did not feed;
verses.34:10: thus says the Lord, the Lord: Look, I am against the shepherds, and I will demand My sheep from their hands, and I will turn them away from shepherding My sheep, and the shepherds will no longer feed them; and I will rescue My sheep from their mouth, and they will no longer be food for them.
verses.34:11: For thus says the Lord: Look, I will seek out My sheep and watch over them.
verses.34:12: Just as a shepherd seeks his flock on a day when there is gloom and cloud in the midst of separated sheep, so I will seek out My sheep and drive them out from every place where they were scattered on a day of cloud and gloom.
verses.34:13: And I will bring them out from the nations and gather them from the countries, and I will bring them into their land, and I will feed them on the mountains of Israel and in the ravines and in every dwelling place of the land;
verses.34:14: in good pasture I will feed them, on the high mountain of Israel. And their sheepfolds will be there and they will lie down, and there they will rest in good delight, and in rich pasture they will be fed on the mountains of Israel.
verses.34:15: I Myself will feed My sheep, and I Myself will give them rest, and they will know that I am the Lord. Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.34:16: The lost I will seek, and the straying I will bring back, and the broken I will bind up, and the failing I will strengthen, and the strong I will guard, and I will feed them with judgment.
verses.34:17: And as for you, sheep, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Look, I will judge between sheep and sheep, rams and male goats.
verses.34:18: And is it not enough for you that you grazed on the fine pasture, yet you trampled down the remainder of your pasture with your feet? And you drank the settled water, yet the rest you stirred up with your feet?
verses.34:19: And My sheep grazed on what was trampled by your feet, and they drank the water stirred up by your feet?
verses.34:20: Therefore, thus says the Lord, the Lord: Look, I will judge between a strong sheep and a weak sheep.
verses.34:21: With your sides and your shoulders you pushed, and with your horns you butted, and every failing one you pressed out.
verses.34:22: And I will save My sheep, and they will never again be plunder, and I will judge between ram and ram.
verses.34:23: And I will raise up over them one shepherd, and he will shepherd them—My servant David—and he will be their shepherd;
verses.34:24: and I, the Lord, will be God to them, and David will be ruler in their midst; I, the Lord, have spoken.
verses.34:25: And I will make with David a covenant of peace, and I will remove evil wild beasts from the land, and they will dwell in the wilderness and sleep in the forests.
verses.34:26: And I will place them around My mountain; and I will give the rain to you, a rain of blessing.
verses.34:27: And the trees in the plain will give their fruit, and the land will give its strength, and they will dwell upon their land in hope of peace, and they will know that I am the Lord when I break their yoke; and I will rescue them from the hand of those who enslaved them,
verses.34:28: and they will no longer be plunder for the nations, and the wild beasts of the land will never again devour them; and they will dwell in hope, and there will be no one terrifying them.
verses.34:29: And I will raise up for them a plant of peace, and they will no longer perish from famine on the land, and they will never again bear the reproach of nations.
verses.34:30: And they will know that I am the Lord their God, and they are My people. House of Israel, says the Lord,
verses.34:31: you are My sheep and the sheep of My flock, and I am the Lord your God, says the Lord, the Lord.'"
verses.35:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.35:2: "Son of man, turn your face toward Mount Seir and prophesy against it,
verses.35:3: and say, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord: Look, I am against you, Mount Seir, and I will stretch out My hand against you and make you a desolation, and you will be made desolate,
verses.35:4: and I will make a desolation of your cities, and you will be desolate, and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.35:5: Because you became an everlasting enemy, and lay in wait for the house of Israel with deceit, by the hand of enemies with a sword, in the time of injustice, at the end;
verses.35:6: therefore, as I live, says the Lord, the Lord, surely you have sinned against blood, and blood will pursue you.
verses.35:7: And I will make Mount Seir a desolation and a waste, and I will destroy from it people and livestock,
verses.35:8: and I will fill hills and your ravines with the wounded, and in all your plains those wounded by the sword will fall in you.
verses.35:9: I will make you an everlasting desolation, and your cities will never again be inhabited, and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.35:10: Because you said, "The two nations and the two countries will be mine, and I will inherit them," though the Lord is there;
verses.35:11: therefore, as I live, says the Lord, I will do to you according to your enmity, and I will be made known to you when I judge you,
verses.35:12: and you will know that I am the Lord. I have heard the voice of your blasphemies, that you said, "The mountains of Israel are desolate; they have been given to us for food,"
verses.35:13: and you spoke boastfully against Me with your mouth; I Myself have heard.
verses.35:14: Thus says the Lord: In the rejoicing of all the earth I will make you desolate;
verses.35:15: you will be desolate, Mount Seir, and all Idumea, and it will be completely consumed; you will know that I am the Lord their God.'"
verses.36:1: And you, son of man, prophesy to the mountains of Israel, and say to the mountains of Israel, "Hear the word of the Lord:
verses.36:2: This is what the Lord, the Lord says: Because the enemy has said against you, 'Aha! Everlasting wastes have become a possession for us,'"
verses.36:3: therefore prophesy and say, "This is what the Lord, the Lord says: Because you have been dishonored and hated by those around you, so that you became a possession for the remaining nations, and you came up as talk on the tongue and as a reproach to the nations,
verses.36:4: therefore, mountains of Israel, hear the word of the Lord: Thus says the Lord to the mountains and to the hills and to the ravines and to the torrents and to the desolated and ruined places and to the forsaken cities, and they have become a plunder and a trampling for the remaining nations all around:
verses.36:5: therefore, this is what the Lord, the Lord says: Surely in the fire of My wrath I have spoken against the rest of the nations and against all Idumea, because they gave My land to themselves for a possession with gladness, dishonoring souls so as to lay waste in plunder."
verses.36:6: Therefore prophesy concerning the land of Israel, and say to the mountains and to the hills and to the ravines and to the valleys, "Thus says the Lord: Look, I have spoken in My jealousy and in My wrath, because you have borne the reproaches of nations.
verses.36:7: Therefore I will lift up My hand against the nations that are all around you; they themselves will receive their dishonor.
verses.36:8: But your grapes, mountains of Israel, and your fruit My people will eat, for they are hoping to come.
verses.36:9: For look, I am for you, and I will look upon you, and you will be cultivated and sown,
verses.36:10: and I will multiply people upon you, all the house of Israel completely; and the cities will be inhabited, and the desolate place will be built.
verses.36:11: And I will multiply people and livestock upon you, and I will settle you as in your beginning, and I will do good to you just as in your former times; and you will know that I am the Lord.
verses.36:12: And I will bring forth people upon you, My people Israel, and they will inherit you, and you will be a possession for them; and you will by no means be bereaved of them any longer."
verses.36:13: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: "Because they said to you, 'You are one who devours people, and you have become bereaved by your nation,'
verses.36:14: therefore you will no longer eat people, and you will no longer bereave your nation," says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.36:15: "And the dishonor of nations will no longer be heard against you, and you will by no means bear the reproaches of peoples," says the Lord, the Lord.
verses.36:16: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.36:17: "Son of man, the house of Israel dwelt upon their land, and they defiled it by their way and by their idols and their impurities, and like the impurity of a menstruating woman their way became before My face.
verses.36:18: And I poured out My wrath upon them,
verses.36:19: and I scattered them among the nations, and I dispersed them through the countries; according to their way and according to their sin I judged them.
verses.36:20: And they went into the nations where they went, and they profaned My holy name when it was said of them, 'These are the people of the Lord, and they have gone out from His land.'
verses.36:21: And I spared them for the sake of My holy name, which the house of Israel profaned among the nations where they went.
verses.36:22: Therefore say to the house of Israel, 'Thus says the Lord: It is not for you that I am acting, house of Israel, but rather for the sake of My holy name, which you profaned among the nations where you went.
verses.36:23: And I will sanctify My great name that was profaned among the nations, which you profaned in their midst; and the nations will know that I am the Lord, when I am sanctified in you before their eyes.
verses.36:24: And I will take you from the nations and gather you from all the lands, and I will bring you into your land.
verses.36:25: And I will sprinkle clean water upon you, and you will be cleansed from all your impurities and from all your idols, and I will cleanse you,
verses.36:26: and I will give you a new heart, and I will place a new spirit within you, and I will take away the stony heart from your flesh and give you a heart of flesh.
verses.36:27: And I will place My Spirit within you, and I will cause you to walk in My statutes and to keep My judgments and do them.
verses.36:28: And you will dwell upon the land that I gave to your fathers, and you will be a people to Me, and I will be God to you.
verses.36:29: And I will save you from all your impurities, and I will summon the grain and multiply it, and I will not bring famine upon you;
verses.36:30: and I will multiply the fruit of the tree and the produce of the field, so that you may not receive the reproach of famine among the nations.
verses.36:31: And you will remember your evil ways and your practices that were not good, and you will feel loathing before their face because of your lawless deeds and over their abominations.
verses.36:32: It is not because of you that I am acting, says the Lord, the Lord; it is known to you. Be ashamed and humiliated because of your ways, house of Israel.'"
verses.36:33: Thus says Adonai the Lord: "On the day when I cleanse you from all your lawless deeds, I will also settle the cities, and desolate places will be built;
verses.36:34: and the ruined land will be worked, whereas it had become ruined before the eyes of everyone passing by.
verses.36:35: And they will say, 'That ruined land has become like a garden of delight, and the desolate and ruined and demolished cities have become fortified and inhabited.'
verses.36:36: And the nations, as many as are left around you, will know that I, the Lord, have built the torn-down places and planted the ruined places; I, the Lord, have spoken, and I will do it."
verses.36:37: Thus says Adonai the Lord: "Yet for this I will be sought by the house of Israel, to do it for them: I will multiply them with people like sheep,
verses.36:38: like holy sheep, like the sheep of Jerusalem at her feasts; so the desolate cities will be full of flocks of people, and they will know that I am the Lord."
verses.37:1: And the hand of the Lord came upon me, and the Lord brought me out in the Spirit and set me in the middle of the plain, and it was full of human bones.
verses.37:2: And He led me around them all the way around, and look, there were very many upon the face of the plain, very dry.
verses.37:3: And He said to me, "Son of man, will these bones live?" And I said, "Lord, You know these things."
verses.37:4: And He said to me, "Prophesy to these bones, and you will say to them, 'Dry bones, hear the word of the Lord:
verses.37:5: Thus says the Lord to these bones: Look, I am bringing a spirit of life into you,
verses.37:6: and I will place sinews upon you, and I will bring flesh up upon you, and I will stretch skin over you, and I will put My Spirit into you, and you will live; and you will know that I am the Lord.'"
verses.37:7: And I prophesied just as He commanded me. And it happened while I prophesied that, look, there was a shaking, and the bones came together, each one to its joint.
verses.37:8: And I looked, and see, sinews and flesh were growing upon them, and skin was coming up over them on top, and there was no spirit in them.
verses.37:9: And He said to me, "Prophesy to the spirit; prophesy, son of man, and say to the spirit, 'Thus says the Lord: Come from the four winds and breathe into these dead ones, and let them live.'"
verses.37:10: And I prophesied just as He commanded me; and the spirit entered into them and they lived, and they stood upon their feet, a very great assembly.
verses.37:11: And the Lord spoke to me, saying, "Son of man, these bones are all the house of Israel, and they say, 'Our bones have become dry, our hope has perished, we are lost.'
verses.37:12: Therefore prophesy and say, 'Thus says the Lord: Look, I am opening your tombs, and I will bring you up out of your tombs, and I will bring you into the land of Israel,
verses.37:13: and you will know that I am the Lord, when I open your graves to bring My people up out of the graves.
verses.37:14: And I will put My Spirit into you, and you will live, and I will place you upon your land, and you will know that I, the Lord, have spoken and will do it, says the Lord.'"
verses.37:15: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.37:16: "Son of man, take for yourself a rod and write upon it, 'Judah and the sons of Israel who are joined to him'; and you will take a second rod for yourself and write on it, 'For Joseph, the rod of Ephraim, and all the sons of Israel who are added to him.'
verses.37:17: And you will join them to one another for yourself into one rod to bind them, and they will be in your hand.
verses.37:18: And it will happen when the sons of your people say to you, 'Will you not tell us what these things mean to you?'
verses.37:19: then you will say to them, 'Thus says the Lord: Look, I will take the tribe of Joseph, which is by the hand of Ephraim, and the tribes of Israel that are joined to him, and I will place them upon the tribe of Judah, and they will become one rod in the hand of Judah.'
verses.37:20: And the rods on which you wrote will be in your hand before them,
verses.37:21: and you will say to them, 'This is what the Lord, the Lord says: Look, I am taking all the house of Israel from the midst of the nations where they went, and I will gather them from all those around them and bring them into the land of Israel,
verses.37:22: and I will make them into a nation in My land and on the mountains of Israel; and one ruler will be theirs, and they will no longer be two nations, nor will they by any means be divided any longer into two kingdoms,
verses.37:23: so that they may no longer be defiled by their idols. And I will rescue them from all their lawless deeds in which they sinned, and I will cleanse them, and they will be a people to Me, and I, the Lord, will be God to them.
verses.37:24: And My servant David will be ruler in their midst; there will be one shepherd of all; for they will walk in My ordinances, and they will keep My judgments and do them.
verses.37:25: And they will dwell upon their land that I have given to My servant Jacob, where their fathers dwelt; and they themselves will dwell upon it. And David My servant will be ruler forever.
verses.37:26: And I will make a covenant of peace with them; it will be an everlasting covenant with them. And I will place My sanctuary in their midst forever,
verses.37:27: and My dwelling will be among them, and I will be God to them, and they will be My people.
verses.37:28: And the nations will know that I am the Lord who sanctifies them, when My sanctuary is in their midst forever.'"
verses.38:1: And the word of the Lord came to me, saying,
verses.38:2: "Son of man, set your face against Gog and the land of Magog, ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and prophesy against him,
verses.38:3: and say to him, 'Thus says the Lord, the Lord:
verses.38:4: Look, I am against the ruler of Rosh, Meshech, and Tubal, and I will gather you and all your force, horses and horsemen, all clothed in breastplates, with a large assembly—shields and helmets and swords;
verses.38:5: Persians and Ethiopians and Libyans, all with helmets and shields,
verses.38:6: Gomer and all those around him, the house of Togarmah from the farthest north and all those around him, and many nations with you.
verses.38:7: Be prepared, prepare yourself, you and all your assembly, those gathered with you, and you will be a guard for Me.
verses.38:8: After many days he will be prepared, and at the end of years he will come and arrive in the land brought back from the sword, of those gathered from many nations, upon the land of Israel, which became completely desolate; and he has come out from the nations, and they will all dwell in peace.
verses.38:9: And you will go up like rain, and he will come like a cloud to cover the land, and you will be there, you and all those around you, and many nations with you.
verses.38:10: Thus says the Lord, the Lord: And it will be in that day that words will come up into your heart, and you will think evil thoughts,
verses.38:11: and you will say, "I will go up against a cast-off land; I will come against those who are at rest in quietness and dwelling in peace, all of them dwelling in a land in which there is no wall nor bars, and they have no gates,
verses.38:12: to take plunder and to seize their spoil, to turn my hand against the desolate land that has been settled, and against a nation gathered from many nations, who have acquired possessions, dwelling upon the navel of the earth."
verses.38:13: Sheba and Dedan and the Carthaginian merchants and all their villages will say to you, "Are you coming for plunder, to plunder and to seize spoil? Have you gathered your assembly to take silver and gold, to carry away possessions, to seize spoil?"'
verses.38:14: Therefore prophesy, son of man, and say to Gog, 'Thus says the Lord: In that day, when My people Israel are settled in peace, will you not be roused?
verses.38:15: And you will come from your place, from the farthest north, and many nations with you, all of them riders of horses, a great assembly and a large force;
verses.38:16: and you will go up against My people Israel like a cloud to cover the land. It will be in the last days, and I will bring you up against My land, so that all the nations may know Me when I am sanctified in you before them.
verses.38:17: Thus says the Lord, the Lord to Gog: You are the one about whom I spoke before the former days through the hand of My servants the prophets of Israel, in those days and years, to bring you against them.
verses.38:18: And it will be in that day, on the day when Gog comes against the land of Israel, says the Lord, the Lord, that My fury will rise up,
verses.38:19: and My zeal. In the fire of My wrath I have spoken: Surely in that day there will be a great earthquake upon the land of Israel,
verses.38:20: and the fish of the sea and the birds of the sky and the wild beasts of the field and all the creeping things that creep upon the earth and all the people who are upon the face of the earth will be shaken from the presence of the Lord; and the mountains will be split apart, and the ravines will fall, and every wall will fall to the ground.
verses.38:21: And I will summon against it even every terror, says the Lord; the sword of a man will be against his brother.
